<untrusted-project-content path="assets/annotate.jsx" etag="1790578986323586">
/* ===== Self-Annotate screen — manual event tagging =====
   Reuses the Fightlytics player look & feel. User selects a fighter
   (click box / R / B), then logs the event that fighter triggered
   via the palette or a keyboard shortcut. Hand strikes follow the
   numeric boxing convention (1 jab · 2 straight · 3-4 hooks · 5-6
   uppercuts). Annotations auto-save and show in a feed that behaves
   like the live player feed (click to seek). */
const { useState, useEffect, useRef, useMemo, useCallback } = React;
const AF = window.FIGHT;
const A_RED = 'var(--f-red)',A_BLUE = 'var(--f-blue)';

/* ---- annotation taxonomy (palette + key bindings) ----
   Hand strikes are keyed AND labelled by their boxing number. */
const TOOL_GROUPS = [
{ group: 'Strikes', note: 'Hand strikes use boxing numbers', items: [
  { key: '1', num: '1', cat: 'strike', sub: 'Landed', name: 'Jab', text: (f) => `${f} jab to the head` },
  { key: '2', num: '2', cat: 'strike', sub: 'Landed', name: 'Straight right', text: (f) => `${f} straight right to the head` },
  { key: '3', num: '3', cat: 'strike', sub: 'Landed', name: 'Left hook', text: (f) => `${f} left hook to the head` },
  { key: '4', num: '4', cat: 'strike', sub: 'Landed', name: 'Right hook', text: (f) => `${f} right hook to the body` },
  { key: '5', num: '5', cat: 'strike', sub: 'Landed', name: 'Left uppercut', text: (f) => `${f} left uppercut on the inside` },
  { key: '6', num: '6', cat: 'strike', sub: 'Landed', name: 'Right uppercut', text: (f) => `${f} right uppercut on the inside` },
  { key: 'c', cat: 'strike', sub: 'Landed', name: 'Calf kick', text: (f) => `${f} calf kick` },
  { key: 'l', cat: 'strike', sub: 'Landed', name: 'Low kick', text: (f) => `${f} low kick` },
  { key: 'm', cat: 'strike', sub: 'Landed', name: 'Middle kick', text: (f) => `${f} middle kick to the body` },
  { key: 'h', cat: 'strike', sub: 'Landed', name: 'High kick', text: (f) => `${f} high kick to the head` },
  { key: 'e', cat: 'strike', sub: 'Landed', name: 'Elbow', text: (f) => `${f} elbow` },
  { key: 'n', cat: 'strike', sub: 'Landed', name: 'Knee', text: (f) => `${f} knee in the clinch` }]
},
{ group: 'Grappling', items: [
  { key: 't', cat: 'grapple', sub: 'Attempt', name: 'Takedown attempt', text: (f) => `${f} shoots for a takedown` },
  { key: 'd', cat: 'grapple', sub: 'Defended', name: 'Takedown defended', text: (f) => `${f} defends the takedown` },
  { key: 's', cat: 'event', sub: 'Submission attempt', name: 'Submission', text: (f) => `${f} threatens a submission` }]
},
{ group: 'Outcome', items: [
  { key: 'x', cat: 'strike', sub: 'KNOCKDOWN', name: 'Knockdown', text: (f) => `${f} scores a KNOCKDOWN` }]
},
{ group: 'Fight state', items: [
  { key: 'w', cat: 'state', sub: '', name: 'Striking', text: () => 'Fight state \u2192 STRIKING', nf: true },
  { key: 'g', cat: 'state', sub: '', name: 'Grappling', text: () => 'Fight state \u2192 GRAPPLING', nf: true }]
}];

const KEYMAP = {};
TOOL_GROUPS.forEach((g) => g.items.forEach((it) => {KEYMAP[it.key] = it;}));

/* ---- round / fight timing markers (no fighter, special handling) ---- */
const ROUND_TOOLS = [
{ kind: 'start', name: 'Round start', icon: 'play_circle', color: 'var(--green-500)' },
{ kind: 'end', name: 'Round end', icon: 'stop_circle', color: 'var(--green-500)' },
{ kind: 'fightend', name: 'End of fight', icon: 'sports_score', color: 'var(--purple-600)' }];

const PLAYBACK_KEYS = [
{ k: ['Space'], label: 'Play / pause' },
{ k: ['\u2190', '\u2192'], label: 'Seek \u00b11 s' },
{ k: ['\u21e7', '\u2190/\u2192'], label: 'Seek \u00b15 s' },
{ k: [',', '.'], label: 'Step \u00b11 frame' }];

const EDIT_KEYS = [
{ k: ['R'], label: 'Select red corner' },
{ k: ['B'], label: 'Select blue corner' },
{ k: ['Esc'], label: 'Deselect fighter' },
{ k: ['Z'], label: 'Undo last event' }];


/* ---- clickable fighter boxes over the still ---- */
const BOXES = [
{ key: 'red', x: 18.5, y: 13, w: 21, h: 71, side: 'left' },
{ key: 'blue', x: 53.5, y: 11, w: 21.5, h: 69, side: 'right' }];

function FighterBoxes({ selected, onSelect }) {
  return (
    <>
      {BOXES.map((b) => {
        const f = AF.fighters[b.key];const sel = selected === b.key;
        return (
          <button key={b.key} className="fbox" onClick={(e) => {e.stopPropagation();onSelect(b.key);}}
          style={{ position: 'absolute', left: b.x + '%', top: b.y + '%', width: b.w + '%', height: b.h + '%', cursor: 'pointer',
            borderRadius: 6, padding: 0, transition: 'transform .1s',
            border: sel ? `2.5px solid ${f.color}` : '2px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.45)',
            background: sel ? `color-mix(in srgb, ${f.color} 15%, transparent)` : 'transparent',
            boxShadow: sel ? `0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, ${f.color} 32%, transparent)` : 'none' }}>
            <span style={{ position: 'absolute', top: -27, [b.side]: 0, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
              background: sel ? f.color : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.62)', color: sel ? '#0a0a0a' : '#fff',
              fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 800, padding: '3px 8px', borderRadius: 5, backdropFilter: 'blur(6px)', letterSpacing: '0.02em' }}>
              {sel && <span className="mi" style={{ fontSize: 14 }}>check</span>}
              {f.name}
              <span className="kbd" style={{ height: 17, minWidth: 17, fontSize: 11, background: sel ? 'rgba(0,0,0,0.25)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.12)', color: sel ? '#0a0a0a' : '#fff', borderColor: 'transparent' }}>{b.key === 'red' ? 'R' : 'B'}</span>
            </span>
          </button>);

      })}
    </>);

}

/* ---- video stage with selection + toast ---- */
function AnnotateStage({ player, selected, onSelect, toast }) {
  const { time, playing, toggle } = player;
  const rd = window.activeRound(time);
  const r = AF.rounds[rd - 1];const clk = AF.fmt(Math.max(0, r.end - time));
  return (
    <div onClick={toggle}
    style={{ position: 'relative', width: '100%', aspectRatio: '2150 / 1245', background: '#000', borderRadius: 16,
      overflow: 'hidden', border: '1px solid var(--border-glass)', cursor: 'pointer' }}>
      <img src="assets/video-still.jpg" alt="" draggable="false"
      style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0, width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover', userSelect: 'none' }} />
      <FighterBoxes selected={selected} onSelect={onSelect} />
      {/* top chrome */}
      <div style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 0, left: 0, right: 0, height: 64, pointerEvents: 'none', background: 'transparent' }}></div>
      <div style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 14, left: 16, display: 'flex', gap: 8, alignItems: 'center', pointerEvents: 'none' }}>
        <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, background: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.55)', color: '#fff',
          fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 800, letterSpacing:0, padding: '4px 9px', borderRadius: 6 }}>
          <span className="mi" style={{ fontSize: 14, color: 'var(--accent)' }}>edit_note</span>Annotating
        </span>
        <span style={{ background: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)', color: '#fff', fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, padding: '4px 10px', borderRadius: 6, letterSpacing: '0.04em' }}>ROUND {rd} · {clk}</span>
      </div>
      {/* selected fighter chip */}
      {selected &&
      <div style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 14, right: 16, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 7, pointerEvents: 'none',
        background: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)', padding: '5px 11px', borderRadius: 6, border: `1px solid ${AF.fighters[selected].color}` }}>
          <span style={{ width: 8, height: 8, borderRadius: 2, background: AF.fighters[selected].color }}></span>
          <span style={{ fontSize: 11.5, fontWeight: 800, color: '#fff', letterSpacing: '0.03em' }}>{AF.fighters[selected].name}</span>
        </div>
      }
      {/* pause glyph */}
      {!playing && !toast &&
      <div style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0, display: 'grid', placeItems: 'center', pointerEvents: 'none' }}>
          <div style={{ width: 70, height: 70, borderRadius: '50%', background: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)', display: 'grid', placeItems: 'center', border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2)' }}>
            <span className="mi fill" style={{ fontSize: 36, color: '#fff' }}>play_arrow</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      }
      {/* toast feedback */}
      {toast &&
      <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: '50%', bottom: 22, transform: 'translateX(-50%)', pointerEvents: 'none',
        display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 9, padding: '9px 16px', borderRadius: 10,
        background: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.86)', backdropFilter: 'blur(10px)', border: `1px solid ${toast.color}`,
        boxShadow:'none', animation: 'feed-in .2s ease-out' }}>
          <span className="mi" style={{ fontSize: 18, color: toast.color }}>{toast.icon}</span>
          <span style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 700, color: '#fff' }}>{toast.text}</span>
        </div>
      }
    </div>);

}

/* ---- transport with frame stepping ---- */
function AnnotateControls({ player }) {
  const { time, playing, toggle, seek } = player;
  const pct = time / AF.duration * 100;
  const onSeek = (e) => {const r = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();seek((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width * AF.duration);};
  const Btn = ({ onClick, children, title }) =>
  <button className="icon-btn" title={title} onClick={onClick}
  style={{ width: 38, height: 38, padding: 0, color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>{children}</button>;

  return (
    <div className="glass" style={{ padding: '14px 18px', borderRadius: 14, marginTop: 10 }}>
      <div onClick={onSeek} style={{ height: 6, borderRadius: 6, cursor: 'pointer', position: 'relative',
        background: `linear-gradient(to right, var(--accent) ${pct}%, rgba(255,255,255,0.1) ${pct}%)` }}>
        <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: `calc(${pct}% - 7px)`, top: -4, width: 14, height: 14, borderRadius: '50%', background: 'var(--accent)', boxShadow:'none' }}></div>
      </div>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 9, marginTop: 13 }}>
        <Btn title="Back 5 s" onClick={() => seek(time - 5)}><span className="mi" style={{ fontSize: 20 }}>replay_5</span></Btn>
        <Btn title="Previous frame (,)" onClick={() => seek(time - 1 / AF.fps)}><span className="mi" style={{ fontSize: 20 }}>navigate_before</span></Btn>
        <button onClick={toggle} style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, background: 'linear-gradient(135deg,var(--accent),var(--accent-2))',
          color: 'var(--cyan-on)', border: 'none', borderRadius: 9, padding: '9px 20px', fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 13, cursor: 'pointer', boxShadow:'none' }}>
          <span className="mi fill" style={{ fontSize: 20 }}>{playing ? 'pause' : 'play_arrow'}</span>{playing ? 'Pause' : 'Play'}</button>
        <Btn title="Next frame (.)" onClick={() => seek(time + 1 / AF.fps)}><span className="mi" style={{ fontSize: 20 }}>navigate_next</span></Btn>
        <Btn title="Forward 5 s" onClick={() => seek(time + 5)}><span className="mi" style={{ fontSize: 20 }}>forward_5</span></Btn>
        <span style={{ fontVariantNumeric: 'tabular-nums', color: 'var(--text-tertiary)', fontWeight: 600, fontSize: 13, marginLeft: 6 }}>
          {AF.fmt(time)} <span style={{ color: 'var(--text-disabled)' }}>/ {AF.fmt(AF.duration)}</span></span>
        <span style={{ flex: 1 }}></span>
        <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: 'var(--text-disabled)', fontVariantNumeric: 'tabular-nums', letterSpacing: '0.02em' }}>Frame {Math.round(time * AF.fps).toLocaleString()} · {AF.fps} fps</span>
      </div>
    </div>);

}

/* ---- active-fighter selector ---- */
function FighterSelect({ selected, onSelect, hint }) {
  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 10 }}>
      {BOXES.map((b) => {
        const f = AF.fighters[b.key];const sel = selected === b.key;
        return (
          <button key={b.key} onClick={() => onSelect(b.key)}
          style={{ cursor: 'pointer', textAlign: 'left', padding: '12px 14px', borderRadius: 12, transition: 'transform .12s',
            border: `1.5px solid ${sel ? f.color : hint ? 'var(--f-red)' : 'var(--border-glass)'}`,
            background: sel ? `color-mix(in srgb, ${f.color} 12%, transparent)` : 'var(--surface-inner)',
            boxShadow: sel ? `0 0 20px -6px ${f.color}` : 'none',
            animation: hint && !sel ? 'pulse-ring 1s ease-out 2' : 'none' }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 9 }}>
              <span style={{ width: 11, height: 11, borderRadius: 3, background: f.color, boxShadow: sel ? `0 0 10px ${f.color}` : 'none' }}></span>
              <span className="font-display" style={{ fontSize: 22, color: 'var(--text-primary)', lineHeight: 1 }}>{f.name}</span>
              <span className="kbd" style={{ marginLeft: 'auto' }}>{b.key === 'red' ? 'R' : 'B'}</span>
            </div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: 'var(--text-muted)', fontWeight: 600, marginTop: 5 }}>{f.corner} · {f.record}</div>
          </button>);

      })}
    </div>);

}

/* ---- event palette ---- */
function EventPalette({ selected, onLog }) {
  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 14 }}>
      {TOOL_GROUPS.map((g) =>
      <div key={g.group}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'baseline', gap: 8, marginBottom: 9 }}>
            <div className="label" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>{g.group}</div>
            {g.note && <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: 'var(--text-disabled)', fontWeight: 600 }}>{g.note}</div>}
          </div>
          <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(2,1fr)', gap: 8 }}>
            {g.items.map((it) => {
            const c = window.eventColor({ cat: it.cat, sub: it.sub });
            const blocked = !it.nf && !selected;
            return (
              <button key={it.key} onClick={(e) => {e.currentTarget.blur();onLog(it);}}
              title={blocked ? 'Select a fighter first' : it.name}
              style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 9, padding: '9px 11px', borderRadius: 10, cursor: 'pointer', textAlign: 'left',
                border: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)', background: 'var(--surface-inner)', borderLeft: `3px solid ${c}`,
                opacity: blocked ? 0.42 : 1, transition: 'transform .1s,opacity .12s' }}>
                  {it.num ?
                  <span className="punch-num" style={{ color: c, borderColor: `color-mix(in srgb, ${c} 45%, transparent)`, background: `color-mix(in srgb, ${c} 14%, transparent)` }}>{it.num}</span> :
                  <span className="kbd">{it.key.toUpperCase()}</span>}
                  <span className="mi" style={{ fontSize: 18, color: c }}>{window.eventIcon({ cat: it.cat, sub: it.sub })}</span>
                  <span style={{ fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: 600, color: 'var(--text-secondary)', lineHeight: 1.1 }}>{it.name}</span>
                </button>);

          })}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>);

}

/* ---- round & fight-timing markers ---- */
function RoundMarkers({ onMark }) {
  return (
    <div>
      <div className="label" style={{ fontSize: 11, marginBottom: 9 }}>Rounds &amp; timing</div>
      <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr 1fr', gap: 8 }}>
        {ROUND_TOOLS.map((rt) =>
        <button key={rt.kind} onClick={() => onMark(rt.kind)} title={rt.name}
        style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', gap: 6, padding: '12px 8px', borderRadius: 10, cursor: 'pointer',

Base directory for this skill: /private/tmp/claude-502/bundled-skills/2.1.283/f80537ee253f4db1788b42b806e92aff/dataviz

# Data Visualization

A chart is **read by people and executed by you**. This skill turns "make it look
good" into a procedure with checks, so the result is right by construction rather
than by taste.

**The method here is design-system-agnostic.** Nothing in the procedure, the form
heuristic, the six checks, or the mark specs is specific to one product. A design
system supplies a small set of *parameters* (its ramps, a categorical order, a
diverging pair, a status palette, a texture, its surfaces, its filter components);
the method consumes them unchanged. A **validated default palette** is the
reference instance, fully specified in `references/palette.md`. To target your
brand, read that file's structure and substitute its values - touch nothing else.

> The single most important habit: **the color part is computable, so compute it.**
> Never eyeball whether a palette is colorblind-safe - run `scripts/validate_palette.js`.

## The procedure - do these in order

Color comes LAST. Most bad charts pick colors first.

1. **Pick the form.** What is the data's job - magnitude, identity, polarity, a
   single headline, change-over-time? The job picks the chart type, and sometimes
   the answer is *not a chart* (a stat tile or hero number). -> `references/choosing-a-form.md`
2. **Assign color by the job it does.** Categorical (identity), sequential
   (magnitude), diverging (polarity), or status (state) - each has one rule.
   Assign categorical hues in fixed order, never cycled. -> `references/color-formula.md`
3. **VALIDATE the palette - run the script, don't reason about Delta E.**
   `node scripts/validate_palette.js "<hex,hex,...>" --mode light` (relative to
   this skill's base directory - or load it as `<script type="module">` in the
   chart's own page, where it reads
   `data-palette` off `<body>` and logs a `console.table` report). It returns
   pass/fail on the lightness band, chroma floor, adjacent-pair CVD separation,
   the normal-vision floor, and contrast. Fix anything that FAILs before continuing. Re-run for
   `--mode dark` with that mode's surface.
4. **Apply mark specs & spacers.** Thin marks, 4px rounded data-ends anchored to
   the baseline, 2px lines, >=8px markers, a 2px surface gap between fills (stacked
   segments and adjacent bars alike) and a 2px surface ring on overlapping marks,
   selective direct labels. -> `references/marks-and-anatomy.md`
5. **Add the hover layer - by default.** An HTML/SVG chart *is* interactive; ship
   a crosshair+tooltip on line/area and a per-mark hover tooltip on bar/dot/cell.
   The only form that skips it is a bare stat tile with no plot. Hit targets bigger
   than the mark; filters in one row above the charts. -> `references/interaction.md`
6. **Final accessibility pass.** For >= 2 series a legend is always present and <= 4
   are also direct-labeled (a single series needs no legend box - the title names
   it), so identity is never color-alone; a table view exists; dark mode is **selected** - its own
   steps from the same ramps, validated against the dark surface, not an automatic
   flip; texture is available for the CVD/print/forced-colors case.
7. **Render it and look at it.** The validator checks color, not layout - open or
   screenshot the output and eyeball it for label collisions, geometry, and overflow
   before calling it done.

Then check the result against **`references/anti-patterns.md`** - it is the catalog
of what goes wrong. If your chart matches an entry, it's wrong.

## Non-negotiables (true in every design system)

- **Assign categorical hues in fixed order, never cycled.** A 9th series is never a
  generated hue - it folds into "Other," small multiples, or composite encoding.
- **One axis.** Never a dual-axis chart (two y-scales). Two measures of different
  scale -> two charts, small multiples, or indexed to a common base. *(This is the
  #1 chart mistake - see anti-patterns.)*
- **Color follows the entity, never its rank.** A filter that changes the series
  count must not repaint the survivors.
- **Sequential = one hue, light->dark. Diverging = two hues + a neutral gray
  midpoint.** Never a rainbow; never a hue at the diverging midpoint.
- **Run the validator before shipping any categorical palette.** CVD Delta E >= 8 is the
  target (OKLab ×100); 6-8 is a floor that is legal ONLY with secondary encoding. A
  normal-vision floor below 15 is a hard FAIL - full-color readers can't tell the
  pair apart; re-step it on the adjacent pairlist (secondary encoding does not excuse
  this one); under `--pairs all` cut series or facet instead - see check 4. A contrast WARN
  obligates visible labels or a table view - it is not dismissable.
- **Thin marks; a legend always present for >= 2 series (none for one), with
  selective direct labels (never a number on every point); recessive grid/axes.**
- **Text wears text tokens, never the series color** - values, labels, and legends
  stay in primary/secondary/muted ink; a colored mark beside them carries identity.
- **Status colors are reserved** (good/warning/serious/critical) and never reused
  for "series 4"; they ship with an icon + label, never color alone.

## Plugging in a design system

The method is invariant; only these parameters change per system. The reference
instance - every value filled in - is `references/palette.md`.

| Parameter | What the system provides |
|---|---|
| **Ramps** | the hue scales (named steps) the palette draws from |
| **Categorical theme** | the fixed hue order (a named theme); default + alternates |
| **Sequential hue** | the default single hue for magnitude |
| **Diverging pair** | two warm/cool poles + a neutral midpoint |
| **Status palette** | good / warning / serious / critical - steps distinct from categorical |
| **Texture fill** | one directional hand-drawn fill, used at 45° / 135° |
| **Surfaces** | light & dark chart-surface colors (the validator needs these) |
| **Filter controls** | date-range & dimension controls (behavioral spec in `interaction.md`) |

To onboard a new system: fill those rows, feed its ramps to the validator, and let
it snap each slot to the nearest passing step. Structure and rules stay as written.

## Reference files

| File | What it answers |
|------|-----------------|
| `references/choosing-a-form.md` | Which chart type / is it even a chart? |
| `references/color-formula.md` | The four jobs, the six checks, snap-to-passing |
| `references/marks-and-anatomy.md` | Mark specs, spacers, labels, figures, hero number |
| `references/interaction.md` | Tooltips & hover, filters & time ranges |
| `references/components.md` | The pieces a chart is made of - build each in plain HTML |
| `references/anti-patterns.md` | **What goes wrong - check every chart against this** |
| `references/palette.md` | **The reference palette instance** - every parameter, filled in; swap for your brand's |
| `scripts/validate_palette.js` | Runnable six-checks validator (run it; don't eyeball) |

content.content:
# Reference palette

This is the **reference instance** of the data-viz method: every parameter the
method needs, filled in with a validated default palette. The rest of the skill
is system-agnostic - **to target your brand, substitute this file's values** and
re-run the validator. Nothing else changes.

## How to use these values

Everything below is plain hex. In an HTML chart, **define the slots you use as
CSS custom properties in a local `<style>` block** at the top of the file, then
reference them by role throughout - so the light/dark values swap in one place,
and the chart body is written against roles rather than raw hex:

```css
.viz-root {
  color-scheme: light;
  --surface-1:      #fcfcfb;   /* chart surface */
  --text-primary:   #0b0b0b;
  --text-secondary: #52514e;
  --series-1:       #2a78d6;   /* categorical slot 1 */
  /* ...only the roles this chart uses */
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  :root:where(:not([data-theme="light"])) .viz-root {
    color-scheme: dark;
    --surface-1:      #1a1a19;
    --text-primary:   #ffffff;
    --text-secondary: #c3c2b7;
    --series-1:       #3987e5;
  }
}
:root[data-theme="dark"] .viz-root {
  color-scheme: dark;
  --surface-1:      #1a1a19;
  --text-primary:   #ffffff;
  --text-secondary: #c3c2b7;
  --series-1:       #3987e5;
}
```

Declare the dark values under both scopes as above - the media query covers
the OS setting; the `data-theme` scope covers the viewer's theme toggle,
which must win both ways (the `:not(...)` guard lets a light stamp beat
OS-dark; `:where()` keeps the media block below the toggle scope).

## Categorical palette

Both modes are selected. The dark column is the same eight hues stepped for the
dark surface, not a separate palette:

| Slot | Hue | Light | Dark |
|------|-----|-------|------|
| 1 | blue | `#2a78d6` | `#3987e5` |
| 2 | orange | `#eb6834` | `#d95926` |
| 3 | aqua | `#1baf7a` | `#199e70` |
| 4 | yellow | `#eda100` | `#c98500` |
| 5 | magenta | `#e87ba4` | `#d55181` |
| 6 | green | `#008300` | `#008300` |
| 7 | violet | `#4a3aa7` | `#9085e9` |
| 8 | red | `#e34948` | `#e66767` |

This order passes every hard gate in both modes on the default *adjacent*
pairlist (stacks, bars, lines): worst adjacent CVD Delta E 9.1 light / 8.4 dark
(OKLab ×100, >=8 target), worst adjacent normal-vision Delta E 19.6 light / 19.3
dark (>=15 floor). Under `--pairs all` (scatter, bubble, choropleth, small
multiples) the full eight cannot clear the floors - with all 28 pairs in
play no ordering can (the pairlist no longer depends on order), and
re-stepping is off the table by the documented-palette rule - so those
chart forms carry a series cap: **the first three slots validate all-pairs
in both modes** (worst pair CVD Delta E 9.2 light / 9.4 dark, normal-vision 24.0
light / 20.9 dark - clear of the CVD warn band). Past three, fold to "Other" or
facet: the fourth slot puts yellow and orange on screen
together, and that pair fails the all-pairs floors (normal-vision 13.7
light; CVD 4.8 dark). Three light-mode slots (magenta, yellow, aqua)
sit below 3:1 contrast on the light surface: the **relief rule** applies (ship
visible direct labels or the table view). The dark steps were chosen for the
dark band (OKLCH L ~ 0.48-0.67, >= 3:1 on the dark surface) and validated as a
set. (Ordering history: adopted July 2026 for its more harmonious opening -
the same eight hues and steps as its predecessor, re-ordered, zero hex
changes. The predecessor validated its first FOUR slots all-pairs, with its
dark run in the 6-8 CVD warn band, so secondary encoding was required there;
this order deliberately trades that fourth slot - yellow now sits beside orange -
for better-looking leading colors. Revisit the trade if yellow<->orange
confusion shows up in real charts with four or more series; undoing it is a
pure re-order.) When you swap in your own ramps, hold your palette to the full
gate.

The slot **ordering** is the CVD-safety mechanism, not cosmetic - candidate
orderings were enumerated and only those clearing every adjacent gate in both
modes kept (see `color-formula.md` § Themes); this default is one of the
passing orders, picked among them for its opening colors. When you swap in
your brand's hues, do the same: run the validator on candidate orderings and
choose only among the passing ones.

## Sequential hue

Default single hue: **blue**, light->dark. When two sequential contexts appear at
once, the second takes the next categorical slot's hue (orange), each as its own
one-hue ramp.

| step | hex | step | hex | step | hex | step | hex |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 100 | `#cde2fb` | 250 | `#86b6ef` | 400 | `#3987e5` | 550 | `#1c5cab` |
| 150 | `#b7d3f6` | 300 | `#6da7ec` | 450 | `#2a78d6` | 600 | `#184f95` |

method needs, filled in with a validated default palette. The rest of the skill

re-run the validator. Nothing else changes.

## How to use these values

Everything below is plain hex. In an HTML chart, **define the slots you use as
CSS custom properties in a local `<style>` block** at the top of the file, then
reference them by role throughout - so the light/dark values swap in one place,
and the chart body is written against roles rather than raw hex:

```css
.viz-root {
  color-scheme: light;
  --surface-1:      #fcfcfb;   /* chart surface */
  --text-primary:   #0b0b0b;
  --text-secondary: #52514e;
  --series-1:       #2a78d6;   /* categorical slot 1 */
  /* ...only the roles this chart uses */
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  :root:where(:not([data-theme="light"])) .viz-root {
    color-scheme: dark;
    --surface-1:      #1a1a19;
    --text-primary:   #ffffff;
    --text-secondary: #c3c2b7;
    --series-1:       #3987e5;
  }
}
:root[data-theme="dark"] .viz-root {

  --surface-1:      #1a1a19;
  --text-primary:   #ffffff;
  --text-secondary: #c3c2b7;
  --series-1:       #3987e5;
}

the OS setting; the `data-theme` scope covers the viewer's theme toggle,

1	export interface Fight {
2	  id: number;
3	  video_path: string;
4	  fps: number;
5	  width: number;
6	  height: number;
7	  created_at: string;
8	  state: string;
9	  labeled_at: string | null;
10	  purpose: string;
11	  reported_frames: number | null;
12	  decoded_frames: number | null;
13	  segmentation_needs_review: boolean;
14	  segmentation_review_reason: string | null;
15	  red_fighter_id: number | null;
16	  blue_fighter_id: number | null;
17	  red_fighter_name: string | null;
18	  blue_fighter_name: string | null;
19	}
20	
21	/**
22	 * What the video is for. Set once at upload from the Upload dialog and never
23	 * written again — the AI pipeline does not touch it, so a `reference` fight
24	 * keeps its identity when it is re-run to produce predictions to score against.
25	 */
26	export type FightPurpose = 'training_data' | 'reference' | 'ai_labeled';
27	
28	export const PURPOSE_LABELS: Record<FightPurpose, string> = {
29	  training_data: 'Training data',
30	  reference: 'Reference',
31	  ai_labeled: 'AI labeled',
32	};
33	
34	/**
35	 * Deliberately avoids #ff4d4d/#3aa0ff (corner colours — a badge in either would
36	 * read as "red corner"), #ef4444 (error) and #f59e0b (the rounds-unverified
37	 * warning). Violet is new to the palette. Colour is a redundant channel here
38	 * anyway: every badge carries its text label.
39	 */
40	export const PURPOSE_COLORS: Record<FightPurpose, string> = {
41	  training_data: '#a3c900', // --green-500
42	  reference: '#a78bfa', // violet — no existing semantic
43	  ai_labeled: '#00daf3', // --cyan-400, the AI accent
44	};
45	
46	export const PURPOSE_ICONS: Record<FightPurpose, string> = {
47	  training_data: 'model_training',
48	  reference: 'verified',
49	  ai_labeled: 'auto_awesome',
50	};
51	
52	export const STATE_PROGRESS: Record<string, number> = {
53	  validating: 0,
54	  queued: 0,
55	  detecting: 10,
56	  tracking: 35,
57	  pose: 45,
58	  corners: 70,
59	  scoreboard: 78,
60	  segmenting: 85,
61	  analyzing: 92,
62	  completed: 100,
63	  labeling_in_progress: 96,
64	  labeling_complete: 100,
65	  failed: 0,
66	  invalid: 0,
67	};
68	
69	export const STATE_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
70	  validating: 'Validating video',
71	  queued: 'Queued',
72	  detecting: 'Detecting fighters',
73	  tracking: 'Tracking fighters',
74	  pose: 'Analyzing poses',
75	  corners: 'Identifying corners',
76	  scoreboard: 'Reading scoreboard',
77	  segmenting: 'Segmenting rounds',
78	  analyzing: 'Processing fight',
79	  completed: 'Completed',
80	  labeling_in_progress: 'Labeling in progress',
81	  labeling_complete: 'Labeling complete',
82	  failed: 'Failed',
83	  invalid: 'Invalid video',
84	};
85	
86	/** States where the pipeline has stopped moving on its own — no more live SSE updates expected. */
87	export const TERMINAL_STATES = new Set([
88	  'completed',
89	  'failed',
90	  'invalid',
91	  'labeling_in_progress',
92	  'labeling_complete',
93	]);
94	
95	/** Fight has real analysis data (events/frames/rounds) ready to review in the Player. */
96	export const isFightViewable = (state: string): boolean =>
97	  state === 'completed' || state === 'labeling_complete';
98	
99	/** Fight has fighter_frames/rounds written and is waiting for the user to manually tag events. */
100	export const isLabelingReady = (state: string): boolean =>
101	  state === 'labeling_in_progress';
102	
103	/** Source video failed full-decode validation and was never queued for processing. */
104	export const isInvalid = (state: string): boolean => state === 'invalid';
105	
106	/**
107	 * Segmentation could not corroborate its own round list against the scoreboard,
108	 * so the rounds are a detection-only guess and should be confirmed by hand.
109	 * The pipeline sets this at segmentation time — see ai/video_processing/
110	 * fight_segmentation.py `_review_verdict`. Once labeling has been finished,
111	 * every round has a hand-confirmed label-span (finish-labeling requires it), so
112	 * the guess has already been confirmed and the warning no longer applies.
113	 * `labeled_at` covers the re-opened case: editing a labelled fight puts it back
114	 * in `labeling_in_progress`, but its rounds are still confirmed.
115	 */
116	export const needsRoundReview = (fight: Fight): boolean =>
117	  fight.segmentation_needs_review === true
118	  && fight.state !== 'labeling_complete'
119	  && fight.labeled_at === null;
120	
121	/**
122	 * A hand-labelled fight that has been finished and can be re-opened in
123	 * Annotate for editing (POST /fights/{id}/reopen-labeling). `ai_labeled`
124	 * fights never reach `labeling_complete`, so the state check alone excludes
125	 * them — their events are predictions, which Annotate can't edit.
126	 */
127	export const isLabelEditable = (fight: Fight): boolean =>
128	  fight.state === 'labeling_complete';
129	
130	/** A previously finished fight that has been re-opened in Annotate for editing. */
131	export const isEditingLabels = (fight: Fight): boolean =>
132	  fight.state === 'labeling_in_progress' && fight.labeled_at !== null;

entries.name: TaskCreate
entries.description:
Use this tool to create a structured task list for your current coding session. This helps you track progress, organize complex tasks, and demonstrate thoroughness to the user.
It also helps the user understand the progress of the task and overall progress of their requests.

## When to Use This Tool

Use this tool proactively in these scenarios:

- Complex multi-step tasks - When a task requires 3 or more distinct steps or actions
- Non-trivial and complex tasks - Tasks that require careful planning or multiple operations
- Plan mode - When using plan mode, create a task list to track the work
- User explicitly requests todo list - When the user directly asks you to use the todo list
- User provides multiple tasks - When users provide a list of things to be done (numbered or comma-separated)
- After receiving new instructions - Immediately capture user requirements as tasks
- When you start working on a task - Mark it as in_progress BEFORE beginning work
- After completing a task - Mark it as completed and add any new follow-up tasks discovered during implementation

## When NOT to Use This Tool

Skip using this tool when:
- There is only a single, straightforward task
- The task is trivial and tracking it provides no organizational benefit
- The task can be completed in less than 3 trivial steps
- The task is purely conversational or informational

NOTE that you should not use this tool if there is only one trivial task to do. In this case you are better off just doing the task directly.

## Task Fields

- **subject**: A brief, actionable title in imperative form (e.g., "Fix authentication bug in login flow")
- **description**: What needs to be done
- **activeForm** (optional): Present continuous form shown in the spinner when the task is in_progress (e.g., "Fixing authentication bug"). If omitted, the spinner shows the subject instead.

All tasks are created with status `pending`.

## Tips

- Create tasks with clear, specific subjects that describe the outcome
- After creating tasks, use TaskUpdate to set up dependencies (blocks/blockedBy) if needed
- Check TaskList first to avoid creating duplicate tasks

subject.description: A brief title for the task

activeForm.description: Present continuous form shown in spinner when in_progress (e.g., "Running tests")

metadata.description: Arbitrary metadata to attach to the task

entries.name: TaskUpdate
entries.description:
Use this tool to update a task in the task list.

## When to Use This Tool

**Mark tasks as resolved:**
- When you have completed the work described in a task
- When a task is no longer needed or has been superseded
- IMPORTANT: Always mark your assigned tasks as resolved when you finish them
- After resolving, call TaskList to find your next task

- ONLY mark a task as completed when you have FULLY accomplished it
- If you encounter errors, blockers, or cannot finish, keep the task as in_progress
- When blocked, create a new task describing what needs to be resolved
- Never mark a task as completed if:
  - Tests are failing
  - Implementation is partial
  - You encountered unresolved errors
  - You couldn't find necessary files or dependencies

**Delete tasks:**
- When a task is no longer relevant or was created in error
- Setting status to `deleted` permanently removes the task

**Update task details:**
- When requirements change or become clearer
- When establishing dependencies between tasks

## Fields You Can Update

- **status**: The task status (see Status Workflow below)
- **subject**: Change the task title (imperative form, e.g., "Run tests")
- **description**: Change the task description
- **activeForm**: Present continuous form shown in spinner when in_progress (e.g., "Running tests")
- **owner**: Change the task owner (agent name)
- **metadata**: Merge metadata keys into the task (set a key to null to delete it)
- **addBlocks**: Mark tasks that cannot start until this one completes
- **addBlockedBy**: Mark tasks that must complete before this one can start

## Status Workflow

Status progresses: `pending` → `in_progress` → `completed`

Use `deleted` to permanently remove a task.

## Staleness

Make sure to read a task's latest state using `TaskGet` before updating it.

## Examples

Mark task as in progress when starting work:
```json
{"taskId": "1", "status": "in_progress"}
```

Mark task as completed after finishing work:
```json
{"taskId": "1", "status": "completed"}
```

Delete a task:
```json
{"taskId": "1", "status": "deleted"}
```

Claim a task by setting owner:
```json
{"taskId": "1", "owner": "my-name"}
```

Set up task dependencies:
```json
{"taskId": "2", "addBlockedBy": ["1"]}
```

taskId.description: The ID of the task to update

activeForm.description: Present continuous form shown in spinner when in_progress (e.g., "Running tests")

addBlocks.description: Task IDs that this task blocks

addBlockedBy.description: Task IDs that block this task

metadata.description: Metadata keys to merge into the task. Set a key to null to delete it.

entries.name: WebFetch
entries.description:
IMPORTANT: WebFetch WILL FAIL for authenticated or private URLs. Before using this tool, check if the URL points to an authenticated service (e.g. Google Docs, Confluence, Jira, GitHub). If so, look for a specialized MCP tool that provides authenticated access.
- claude.ai artifact links (claude.ai/artifact/{id} or claude.ai/code/artifact/{uuid}, including preview.claude.ai) are published artifacts: read them with the Artifact tool (action "read"), not WebFetch, curl or a headless browser.

- Fetches content from a specified URL and processes it using an AI model
- Takes a URL and a prompt as input
- Fetches the URL content, converts HTML to markdown
- Processes the content with the prompt using a small, fast model
- Returns the model's response about the content
- Use this tool when you need to retrieve and analyze web content

Usage notes:
  - IMPORTANT: If an MCP-provided web fetch tool is available, prefer using that tool instead of this one, as it may have fewer restrictions.
  - The URL must be a fully-formed valid URL
  - HTTP URLs will be automatically upgraded to HTTPS
  - localhost and other hostnames without a dot are not supported; for a local server, use curl via Bash
  - The prompt should describe what information you want to extract from the page
  - This tool is read-only and does not modify any files
  - Results may be summarized if the content is very large
  - Includes a self-cleaning cache (entries expire after 15 minutes) for faster responses when repeatedly accessing the same URL
  - When a URL redirects to a different host, the tool will inform you and provide the redirect URL in a special format. You should then make a new WebFetch request with the redirect URL to fetch the content.
  - For GitHub URLs, prefer using the gh CLI via Bash instead (e.g., gh pr view, gh issue view, gh api).

## Done — Annotate page redesign implemented

Pulled `Annotate.html` + its assets (`annotate.jsx`, `brand.css`, `components.jsx`, `fight-data.js`, `tweaks.js`) from the Claude Design project, compared against the real `frontend/src/pages/Annotate.tsx` tree, and applied the visual language app-wide (per your call on scope) while keeping every real behavior the mockup doesn't have — corner-swap/excluded spans, round-review banner, finish/reopen labeling, delete-fight flow, drag-editable rounds.

**Files changed:**
- `src/index.css` — new ember-orange brand tokens (`--accent:#ff4d1c` etc.), flattened `.glass`/`.pill`/`.icon-btn`/`.btn-glass` (dropped the blur), pill-shaped `.nav-link`/`.logo`/`.btn-upload`, added `--mono` and new `--state-striking/clinch/ground` tokens
- `src/App.tsx` — removed the ambient-orb + film-grain background layer (brand.css calls for flat black)
- `src/components/Header.tsx` — logo mark + pill nav, de-hardcoded cyan
- `src/components/VideoControls.tsx`, `FrameInfo.tsx`, `FighterOverlay.tsx`, `types/Fight.ts` — de-hardcoded cyan hex to tokens
- `src/pages/Annotate.tsx` — Finish Labeling button + guard-screen cards flattened to token-driven styling
- `src/components/annotate/AnnotationTimeline.tsx` — STATE lane now uses a validated 3-color trio instead of reusing `--f-red`/`--accent`
- `src/components/ModeCard.tsx`, `CornerSelect.tsx`, `UploadDialog.tsx` — reskinned too, since Header's Upload dialog is reachable from Annotate

**Two deliberate deviations from `brand.css`'s literal values**, both documented inline in `index.css`:
1. Kept `--purple-600` and `--green-500` as true distinct hues instead of brand.css's collapse onto orange/ink — several components (truth-vs-predicted dots, SaveStatus, round markers) need them to read as their own color.
2. AnnotationTimeline's STRIKING/CLINCH/GROUND colors were never in brand.css (its mockup only has a 2-state model). I ran them through the dataviz skill's validator against the dark panel surface and the corner colors — this also fixes the known GROUND≈red-corner collision from memory.

**Verified:** `tsc --noEmit` clean, `vite build` succeeds, eslint clean on every touched file (2 pre-existing errors in `CornerSelect`/`UploadDialog` confirmed present before my changes too), and a grep sweep confirms no old cyan hex remains anywhere in Annotate's render tree.

**I could not visually check it** — no browser/screenshot tool is available in this session. Your Vite dev server is already running at `:5173`; all fights in the DB are `labeling_complete`, so `/fights/:id/annotate` shows the restyled "already labeled" card rather than the full editor unless you reopen one for editing. Worth a look before calling it final.

/* ===== Training Data QA — clip player + event detail ===== */
const { useState: uS, useEffect: uE, useRef: uR, useMemo: uM, useCallback: uC } = React;
const TD = window.TD;
const CORNER_C = { R: 'var(--f-red)', B: 'var(--f-blue)' };

/* ---------- the gif-like clip: synthesised skeleton over the frame ---------- */
function SkeletonClip({ ev, i, showSkel, showBox, big }) {
  const f = uM(() => TD.frame(ev, i), [ev.id, i]);
  const fig = (side, o) => {
    const c = CORNER_C[o.corner];
    const J = o.J;
    const dim = side === 'def' ? 0.62 : 1;
    return <g key={side} opacity={dim}>
      {TD.BONES.map(([a, b]) => {
        if (o.hidden.includes(a) || o.hidden.includes(b)) return null;
        return <line key={a + b} x1={J[a][0]} y1={J[a][1]} x2={J[b][0]} y2={J[b][1]}
          stroke={c} strokeWidth={side === 'att' ? 1.5 : 1.2} strokeLinecap="round" opacity={0.92} />;
      })}
      {Object.keys(J).map((k) => o.hidden.includes(k) ? null :
      <circle key={k} cx={J[k][0]} cy={J[k][1]} r={k === 'head' ? 3.6 : 1.15} fill={k === 'head' ? 'none' : c}
        stroke={k === 'head' ? c : 'none'} strokeWidth={k === 'head' ? 1.5 : 0} />)}
      {o.hidden.length > 0 && <line x1={J[o.hidden[0]][0]} y1={J[o.hidden[0]][1]} x2={J[o.hidden[2]][0]} y2={J[o.hidden[2]][1]}
        stroke={c} strokeWidth={0.8} strokeDasharray="1.6 1.6" opacity={0.45} />}
    </g>;
  };
  const box = (o) => {
    const xs = Object.keys(o.J).map((k) => o.J[k][0]), ys = Object.keys(o.J).map((k) => o.J[k][1]);
    const x = Math.min(...xs) - 3, y = Math.min(...ys) - 5, w = Math.max(...xs) - Math.min(...xs) + 6, h = Math.max(...ys) - Math.min(...ys) + 8;
    return <rect x={x} y={y} width={w} height={h} fill="none" stroke={CORNER_C[o.corner]} strokeWidth={0.5}
      strokeDasharray="2 1.6" opacity={0.5} rx={1} />;
  };
  return <svg viewBox="0 0 160 90" style={{ display: 'block', width: '100%', aspectRatio: '16/9', background: 'radial-gradient(120% 100% at 50% 8%, #0e0f12 0%, #050505 68%, #000000 100%)' }}>

    open={(id) => setView({ v: 'detail', cls: cls.name, id })} />;

    <div className="font-display td-done-h">{cls.name} reviewed</div>
    <p className="td-done-p">Every {cls.name.toLowerCase()} event in the export has a verdict. Pick another class or re-open the list.</p>
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 9, flexWrap: 'wrap', justifyContent: 'center' }}>

      <button type="button" className="btn-upload" onClick={() => setView({ v: 'classes' })}>All strikes</button>
    </div>
  </div>;
  else body = <>
    <div className="td-crumb">
      <button type="button" className="td-crumb-btn" onClick={() => setView({ v: 'classes' })}><Icon n="arrow_back" size={15} />All strikes</button>
      <span className="td-crumb-sep">/</span>
      <button type="button" className="td-crumb-btn plain" onClick={() => setView({ v: 'events', cls: cls.name })}>{cls.name}</button>
      <span className="td-crumb-sep">/</span><span className="td-crumb-cur">{ev.tc}</span>
    </div>

      onBack={() => setView({ v: 'events', cls: cls.name })} onJump={onJump}
      queue={evs.filter((e) => !map[e.id] && e.id !== ev.id)} pos={stats(evs, map)} />
  </>;

  return <>
    <TDHeader />
    <div className="td-page">{body}</div>
  </>;
}

const NF = 24;                 /* frames in a clip */
const FPS = 12;                /* playback rate of the snippet */
const TGT_Y = { head: 28, body: 46, leg: 74 };

/* per-class motion config */
const CFG = {
  'Jab':             { limb:'lead', type:'straight', mode:'stand',  tgt:['head','head','head','body'] },
  'Cross':           { limb:'rear', type:'straight', mode:'stand',  tgt:['head','head','body'] },
  'Left hook':       { limb:'lead', type:'arc',      mode:'stand',  tgt:['head','head','body'] },
  'Right hook':      { limb:'rear', type:'arc',      mode:'stand',  tgt:['head','head','body'] },
  'Left uppercut':   { limb:'lead', type:'rise',     mode:'stand',  tgt:['head','body'] },
  'Right uppercut':  { limb:'rear', type:'rise',     mode:'stand',  tgt:['head','body'] },
  'Calf kick':       { limb:'rear', type:'kick',     mode:'stand',  tgt:['leg'] },
  'Low kick':        { limb:'rear', type:'kick',     mode:'stand',  tgt:['leg'] },
  'Middle kick':     { limb:'rear', type:'kick',     mode:'stand',  tgt:['body'] },
  'High kick':       { limb:'rear', type:'kick',     mode:'stand',  tgt:['head'] },
  'Elbow':           { limb:'lead', type:'elbow',    mode:'clinch', tgt:['head'] },
  'Clinch knee':     { limb:'rear', type:'knee',     mode:'clinch', tgt:['body'] },
  'Clinch punch':    { limb:'lead', type:'straight', mode:'clinch', tgt:['head','body'] },
  'Ground and pound':{ limb:'rear', type:'straight', mode:'ground', tgt:['head','head','body'] },
  'Ground knee':     { limb:'rear', type:'knee',     mode:'ground', tgt:['body'] },
  'Takedown landed': { limb:'lead', type:'takedown', mode:'stand',  tgt:['body'] },
};
const MODE_STATE = { stand:'STRIKING', clinch:'CLINCH', ground:'GROUND' };

const FIGHTS = [
  { name:'DRAGOJEVIC vs HONDA', id:52, dur:714, w:0.60 },
  { name:'VITASOVIC vs STOSIC', id:61, dur:900, w:0.27 },
  { name:'MILIDRAGOVIC vs MOOSMAN', id:44, dur:312, w:0.13 },
];
const LABELLERS = ['M. Kovač', 'M. Kovač', 'A. Petrov', null];

/* ---------- deterministic rng ---------- */
function rng(seed) { let s = (seed * 2654435761) >>> 0 || 7; return () => { s = (s * 1664525 + 1013904223) >>> 0; return s / 4294967296; }; }
const pick = (r, a) => a[Math.floor(r() * a.length)];
const fmt = (t) => {
  const m = Math.floor(t / 60), s = Math.floor(t % 60), f = Math.floor((t % 1) * 50);
  return `${m}:${String(s).padStart(2,'0')}.${String(f).padStart(2,'0')}`;
};

/* ---------- flags that make an event worth a second look ---------- */

  { k:'lowconf', t:'Low keypoint confidence', d:'Striking wrist tracked at 0.31 confidence through the impact frames.' },
  { k:'drop',    t:'Limb dropped mid-clip',   d:'The rear arm is missing for 5 of 24 frames — interpolated in the export.' },
  { k:'swap',    t:'Possible corner swap',    d:'Skeleton IDs cross at the impact frame; the label may sit on the wrong fighter.' },
  { k:'jitter',  t:'Skeleton jitter',         d:'Joint positions move 9 px/frame with no matching body motion.' },
  { k:'offset',  t:'Label may be off-frame',  d:'Marked frame sits 7 frames before the extension peak.' },
  { k:'crowd',   t:'Fighters overlap',        d:'Both skeletons occupy the same box — pose assignment is unreliable here.' },
];

/* ---------- build the corpus ---------- */
const classes = [];
const byClass = {};
Object.keys(CFG).forEach((name, ci) => {
  const src = L.events.find((e) => e.name === name);
  if (!src) return;
  const cfg = CFG[name];
  const n = Math.min(src.n, 40);
  const r = rng(ci * 733 + name.length * 31 + src.n);
  const evs = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const fr = r();
    const f = FIGHTS[fr < FIGHTS[0].w ? 0 : fr < FIGHTS[0].w + FIGHTS[1].w ? 1 : 2];
    const t = 8 + r() * (f.dur - 16);
    const corner = r() < (src.r / (src.r + src.b || 1)) ? 'R' : 'B';
    const conf = 0.42 + r() * 0.56;
    const bad = conf < 0.62 || r() < 0.14;
    const flags = [];
    if (bad) { flags.push(DEFECTS[Math.floor(r() * DEFECTS.length)]); if (r() < 0.3) flags.push(DEFECTS[Math.floor(r() * DEFECTS.length)]); }
    evs.push({
      id: name.replace(/\s+/g, '-').toLowerCase() + '-' + i,
      cls: name, key: src.key, trains: src.trains, group: src.g,
      fight: f.name, fightId: f.id, t, tc: fmt(t), frame: 'f' + Math.round(t * 50),
      corner, tgt: pick(r, cfg.tgt), state: MODE_STATE[cfg.mode], mode: cfg.mode,
      conf: +conf.toFixed(2), labeller: pick(r, LABELLERS),
      flags: flags.filter((x, k, a) => a.findIndex((y) => y.k === x.k) === k),
      seed: ci * 977 + i * 41 + 3,
    });
  }
  evs.sort((a, b) => a.fight === b.fight ? a.t - b.t : a.fight < b.fight ? -1 : 1);
  byClass[name] = evs;
  classes.push({ name, key: src.key, group: src.g, trains: src.trains, n: evs.length, cfg });
});

/* ================= pose engine ================= */
const BASE = {
  head:[0,26], neck:[0,35], pelvis:[0,56],
  shL:[6,37], elL:[11,46], wrL:[9,39],
  shR:[-6,37], elR:[-10,47], wrR:[-4,40],
  hipL:[4,55], hipR:[-4,55],
  knL:[9,70], anL:[13,84], knR:[-8,70], anR:[-13,84],
};
const BONES = [['head','neck'],['neck','shL'],['neck','shR'],['shL','elL'],['elL','wrL'],['shR','elR'],['elR','wrR'],
  ['neck','pelvis'],['pelvis','hipL'],['pelvis','hipR'],['hipL','knL'],['knL','anL'],['hipR','knR'],['knR','anR']];
const ARM_L = ['shL','elL','wrL'], ARM_R = ['shR','elR','wrR'];

const lerp = (a, b, t) => [a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * t, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * t];
const qbez = (p0, c, p1, t) => { const u = 1 - t; return [u*u*p0[0] + 2*u*t*c[0] + t*t*p1[0], u*u*p0[1] + 2*u*t*c[1] + t*t*p1[1]]; };

function makePose(cx, dir, crouch) {
  const py = 56 + (1 - crouch) * 16;
  const J = {};
  Object.keys(BASE).forEach((k) => {
    const [dx, y] = BASE[k];

  const a = deg * Math.PI / 180, c = Math.cos(a), s = Math.sin(a);
  Object.keys(J).forEach((k) => {
    const x = J[k][0] - pivot[0], y = J[k][1] - pivot[1];
    J[k] = [pivot[0] + x * c - y * s, pivot[1] + x * s + y * c];

  (keys || Object.keys(J)).forEach((k) => { J[k] = [J[k][0] + dx, J[k][1] + dy]; });
}
function floorTo(J, y) {
  let mx = -1e9; Object.keys(J).forEach((k) => { mx = Math.max(mx, J[k][1]); });
  shift(J, 0, y - mx);
}

/* attack ramp: wind-up → extension peak at 0.45 → retract */
function ramp(p) {
  return p < 0.45 ? Math.pow(p / 0.45, 1.7) : Math.max(0, Math.pow(1 - (p - 0.45) / 0.45, 1.3));
}

  const o = opts || {};
  const cfg = CFG[ev.cls];
  const p = i / (NF - 1);
  const e = ramp(p);
  const tgtY = TGT_Y[ev.tgt] || 46;
  const ground = cfg.mode === 'ground';
  const dist = cfg.mode === 'clinch' ? 26 : ground ? 22 : 40;
  const attDir = 1, defDir = -1;
  const attX = ground ? 60 : 58, defX = ground ? 60 + dist : 58 + dist;

  const A = makePose(attX, attDir, ground ? 0.6 : cfg.type === 'takedown' ? 0.78 - 0.18 * e : 1);
  const D = makePose(defX, defDir, cfg.mode === 'clinch' ? 0.96 : 1);

  if (ground) {
    rotate(D, D.pelvis, -72);
    shift(D, -6, 0);
    floorTo(D, 84);
    floorTo(A, 84);
  }

  /* --- attacker motion --- */
  const lead = cfg.limb === 'lead';
  const W = lead ? 'wrL' : 'wrR', E = lead ? 'elL' : 'elR', S = lead ? 'shL' : 'shR';
  const AN = lead ? 'anL' : 'anR', KN = lead ? 'knL' : 'knR';
  const reach = dist * (ground ? 1.0 : 0.96);
  const aimY = ground ? 70 : tgtY;

  if (cfg.type === 'straight') {
    A[W] = lerp(A[W], [attX + reach, aimY], e);
    A[E] = lerp(A[E], [attX + reach * 0.5, aimY + (ground ? -8 : 2)], e);
    shift(A, 3.5 * e, 0);
  } else if (cfg.type === 'arc') {
    const w1 = [attX + reach * 0.97, aimY];
    A[W] = qbez(A[W], [attX + reach * 0.5, aimY - 17], w1, e);
    A[E] = lerp(A[E], [attX + reach * 0.5, aimY - 7], e);
    shift(A, 2.5 * e, 0);
    rotate(A, A.pelvis, 6 * e);
  } else if (cfg.type === 'rise') {
    const w1 = [attX + reach * 0.94, aimY];
    A[W] = qbez([A[W][0] + 2, 54], [attX + reach * 0.86, 56], w1, e);
    A[E] = lerp(A[E], [attX + reach * 0.48, aimY + 12], e);
    shift(A, 2 * e, 0);
  } else if (cfg.type === 'elbow') {
    A[E] = lerp(A[E], [attX + reach * 0.9, aimY], e);
    A[W] = lerp(A[W], [attX + reach * 0.2, aimY - 9], e);
    shift(A, 2 * e, 0);
  } else if (cfg.type === 'kick') {
    A[AN] = lerp(A[AN], [attX + reach * 0.98, tgtY], e);
    A[KN] = lerp(A[KN], [attX + reach * 0.5, tgtY - (ev.tgt === 'leg' ? 2 : 10)], e);
    shift(A, -5 * e, 0, ['head', 'neck', 'shL', 'shR', 'elL', 'elR', 'wrL', 'wrR']);
    A[lead ? 'anR' : 'anL'] = [A[lead ? 'anR' : 'anL'][0], 84];
  } else if (cfg.type === 'knee') {
    A[KN] = lerp(A[KN], [attX + reach * 0.72, ground ? 62 : 52], e);
    A[AN] = lerp(A[AN], [attX + reach * 0.24, ground ? 76 : 66], e);
    shift(A, 2.5 * e, 0, ['head', 'neck', 'shL', 'shR']);
  } else if (cfg.type === 'takedown') {
    A.wrL = lerp(A.wrL, [attX + reach * 0.98, 58], e);
    A.wrR = lerp(A.wrR, [attX + reach * 0.86, 60], e);
    A.elL = lerp(A.elL, [attX + reach * 0.54, 54], e);
    shift(A, 7 * e, 0);
    rotate(A, A.pelvis, 10 * e);
  }

  /* --- defender reaction --- */
  const rec = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (p - 0.42) / 0.2)) * Math.max(0, 1 - (p - 0.62) / 0.35);
  if (ground) { rotate(D, D.pelvis, -4 * rec); } else {
    shift(D, 4.5 * rec * defDir * -1 * -1, 0, ['head', 'neck', 'shL', 'shR', 'elL', 'elR', 'wrL', 'wrR']);
    rotate(D, D.pelvis, -3 * rec);
  }

  /* --- defect rendering --- */
  const has = (k) => ev.flags.some((f) => f.k === k);
  let hidden = [];
  const r = rng(ev.seed + i * 17);
  const jit = has('jitter') ? 2.6 : has('lowconf') ? 1.1 : 0.35;
  [A, D].forEach((P) => Object.keys(P).forEach((k) => { P[k] = [P[k][0] + (r() - 0.5) * jit, P[k][1] + (r() - 0.5) * jit]; }));
  if (has('drop') && i >= 9 && i <= 13) hidden = lead ? ARM_R : ARM_L;
  if (has('crowd')) shift(D, -9, 0);
  const swapped = has('swap') && i >= 10 && i <= 15;

  const impactJoint = cfg.type === 'kick' ? A[AN] : cfg.type === 'knee' ? A[KN] : cfg.type === 'elbow' ? A[E] : A[W];
  return {
    att: { J: A, corner: swapped ? (ev.corner === 'R' ? 'B' : 'R') : ev.corner, hidden },
    def: { J: D, corner: (swapped ? ev.corner : ev.corner === 'R' ? 'B' : 'R'), hidden: [] },
    e, p, impact: e > 0.86, impactAt: impactJoint, frameNo: i,
    tc: fmt(ev.t - (NF / 2 - i) / FPS / 1.6),
  };
}

return { NF, FPS, classes, byClass, frame, BONES, CFG, FIGHTS, fmt, DEFECTS };
})();

<!DOCTYPE html>

<meta charset="utf-8"/>

<link rel="stylesheet" href="assets/brand.css"/>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Material+Symbols+Outlined:opsz,wght,FILL,GRAD@20..48,100..700,0..1,-50..200"/>
<style>
.td-page{position:relative;z-index:1;max-width:1440px;margin:0 auto;padding:36px 32px 96px}
.kbd{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;min-width:19px;height:19px;padding:0 5px;border-radius:5px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.06);border:1px solid var(--border-glass);font-size:11px;font-weight:800;color:var(--text-tertiary);font-family:ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace}
.td-h1{font-size:clamp(40px,5.2vw,72px);margin:12px 0 0;color:var(--x-ink)}
.td-sub{margin:12px 0 0;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:var(--x-mute);text-wrap:pretty}
.td-sub code{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;color:var(--x-ink)}
/* hero */
.td-hero{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:24px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:14px}
.td-hero-stats{display:flex;gap:26px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-left:auto}
.td-hero-stats>div{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px}
.td-hero-n{font-family:'Manrope',sans-serif;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-0.04em;font-size:44px;letter-spacing:-0.065em;line-height:.9;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--text-primary)}
.td-hero-bar{display:flex;gap:2px;height:6px;border-radius:3px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05);overflow:hidden}
.td-hero-bar .c{background:#ff4d1c}.td-hero-bar .d{background:#9a9892}
.td-hero-foot{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:7px 0 22px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text-muted)}
.td-reset{background:none;border:none;padding:0;cursor:pointer;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text-disabled);text-decoration:underline;font-family:inherit}
.td-reset:hover{color:var(--text-tertiary)}
/* class grid */
.td-group{font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:0;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.26);padding-bottom:8px;margin-bottom:12px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06)}
.td-class-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(228px,1fr));gap:12px}
.td-class{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;padding:18px 18px 20px;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;transition:border-color .14s,transform .14s}
.td-class:hover{border-color:var(--x-line-2);background:var(--x-panel-2)}
.td-class-top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-width:0}
.td-class-name{font-size:15px;font-weight:800;color:var(--text-primary);overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.td-class-thumb{border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--border-subtle)}
.td-class-nums{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:6px}
.td-class-n{font-family:'Manrope',sans-serif;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-0.065em;font-size:40px;line-height:1;color:var(--text-primary)}
.td-class-unit{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0;color:var(--text-muted)}
.td-flagcount{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:3px;margin-left:auto;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:5px;background:rgba(255,177,153,0.12);border:1px solid rgba(255,177,153,0.28);color:#ffb199;font-size:11px;font-weight:800}
.td-prog{display:flex;gap:2px;height:4px;border-radius:2px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05);overflow:hidden}
.td-prog .c{background:#ff4d1c}.td-prog .d{background:#9a9892}
.td-class-foot{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text-muted)}
/* crumbs */
.td-crumb{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;margin-bottom:14px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.td-crumb-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:7px 14px;border-radius:999px;background:transparent;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28);color:var(--text-tertiary);font-family:inherit;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}
.td-crumb-btn:hover{color:var(--x-ink);background:rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
.td-crumb-btn.plain{background:none;border-color:transparent}
.td-crumb-sep{color:var(--text-disabled);font-size:12px}
.td-crumb-cur{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text-secondary);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
/* event list */
.td-list-head{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:16px}
.td-list-head .btn-upload{margin-left:auto}
.td-filter{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:9px 12px;margin-bottom:14px;border-radius:22px;background:var(--x-panel);border:1px solid var(--x-line)}
.td-count{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text-muted)}
.td-rows{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
.td-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:96px 74px minmax(0,1fr) auto auto 18px;gap:13px;align-items:center;padding:8px 16px 8px 8px;border-radius:18px;background:var(--x-panel);border:1px solid var(--border-subtle);cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;text-align:left;transition:border-color .12s,background .12s}
.td-row:hover{background:var(--x-panel-2);border-color:var(--x-line-2)}
.td-row-thumb{display:block;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05)}
.td-row-tc{font-family:ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text-primary)}
.td-row-main{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;min-width:0}
.td-row-fight{font-size:12px;font-weight:800;color:var(--text-secondary);overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.td-row-meta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text-muted)}
.td-row-flag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:3px;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:5px;background:rgba(255,177,153,0.12);border:1px solid rgba(255,177,153,0.26);color:#ffb199;font-size:11px;font-weight:800}
.td-empty{padding:26px;text-align:center;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text-muted)}
/* detail */
.td-detail{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 330px;gap:16px;align-items:start}
.td-detail-main{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;min-width:0}
.td-stage{padding:14px 14px 12px}
.td-stage-top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:11px}
.td-corner{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:3px;flex-shrink:0}
.td-corner.sm{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:2px}
.td-ev-title{font-size:22px;line-height:1;color:var(--text-primary)}
.td-ev-sub{margin-top:3px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text-muted);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.td-screen{width:100%;max-width:720px;margin-inline:auto;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07)}
.td-transport{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:11px}
.td-scrub{flex:1;min-width:140px;accent-color:var(--x-ink);height:4px}
.td-cap{margin-top:9px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text-disabled);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.td-frameno{font-family:ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text-muted)}
.lab-ibtn{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:999px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05);border:1px solid var(--border-glass);color:var(--text-secondary);cursor:pointer;flex-shrink:0}
.lab-ibtn:hover{background:var(--x-panel-2);color:var(--x-ink)}
.td-verdict{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:14px 16px}
.td-verdict-note{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.5;color:var(--text-muted);max-width:44ch;text-wrap:pretty}
.td-verdict-btns{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-left:auto;flex-wrap:wrap}
.td-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;height:48px;padding:0 24px;border-radius:999px;font-family:inherit;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid}
.td-btn.confirm{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-on)}
.td-btn.confirm:hover{background:var(--accent-hover)}
.td-btn.confirm.on{background:var(--accent-hover)}
.td-btn.decline{background:transparent;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.28);color:var(--x-ink)}
.td-btn.decline:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
.td-btn.decline.on{background:var(--x-panel-2);border-color:var(--x-ink)}
.td-kbd{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;min-width:17px;height:17px;border-radius:4px;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.28);font-size:11px;font-weight:800;font-family:ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace;opacity:0.75}
.td-side{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;min-width:0}
.td-clean{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;color:#ff4d1c}
.td-flag{display:flex;gap:8px;padding:9px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.045)}
.td-flag:last-child{border-bottom:none;padding-bottom:0}
.td-flag-t{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:800;color:var(--text-secondary)}
.td-flag-d{margin-top:2px;font-size:11px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.5;color:var(--text-muted);text-wrap:pretty}
.td-qbar{display:flex;height:5px;border-radius:3px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05);overflow:hidden}
.td-qbar>div{background:var(--cyan-400)}
.td-qmeta{margin-top:6px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text-muted)}
.td-qnav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;margin-top:11px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.td-upnext{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;margin-top:11px;padding-top:10px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05)}
.td-upnext-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.22);border:1px solid var(--border-subtle);cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit}
.td-upnext-row:hover{border-color:var(--x-line-2);background:var(--x-panel-2)}
.td-upnext-tc{font-family:ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text-secondary)}
.td-upnext-fight{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text-muted);overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.td-done{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:11px;padding:46px 30px;text-align:center}
.td-done-h{font-size:28px;line-height:1;color:var(--text-primary)}
.td-done-p{margin:0;max-width:46ch;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.6;color:var(--text-muted);text-wrap:pretty}
@media(max-width:1080px){
  .td-detail{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
}
@media(max-width:760px){
  .td-page{padding:18px 16px 70px}

  .td-hero-stats{gap:18px;margin-left:0}

  .td-row-tc{display:none}
  .td-verdict-btns{margin-left:0;width:100%}
  .td-btn{flex:1;justify-content:center}
}
</style>

<untrusted-project-content path="assets/lab-parts.jsx" etag="1790578875786465">
/* ===== Training Lab — shared primitives ===== */
const { useState, useEffect, useRef, useMemo, useCallback } = React;
const L = window.LAB;

/* --- tiny helpers --- */
const cx = (...a) => a.filter(Boolean).join(' ');
const compact = (n) => n >= 1000 ? (n/1000).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/,'') + 'K' : String(n);
/* cyan ramp: t in 0..1 */
const ramp = (t) => {
  const c = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, t));
  return `color-mix(in srgb, #ff4d1c ${8 + c*84}%, #0e0f12)`;
};
const rampInk = (t) => t > 0.55 ? '#190500' : '#f5f5f4';

function Icon({ n, size = 16, fill, style }) {
  return <span className={cx('mi', fill && 'fill')} style={{ fontSize: size, lineHeight: 1, ...style }}>{n}</span>;
}

/* --- section label + heading --- */
function CardHead({ title, meta, children, id }) {
  return (<div style={{ display:'flex', alignItems:'flex-start', gap:14, marginBottom:16, flexWrap:'wrap' }}>
    <div style={{ flex:'1 1 260px', minWidth:0 }}>
      <div style={{ display:'flex', alignItems:'center', gap:9, marginBottom:5 }}>
        <h2 id={id} style={{ margin:0, fontSize:24, fontWeight:800, letterSpacing:'-0.03em', color:'var(--x-ink)' }}>{title}</h2>
      </div>
      {meta && <div style={{ fontSize:13, fontWeight:600, color:'var(--x-mute)', marginTop:4 }}>{meta}</div>}
    </div>
    {children && <div style={{ display:'flex', alignItems:'center', gap:8, flexWrap:'wrap' }}>{children}</div>}
  </div>);
}

/* --- status badge: 5 states, always icon + text --- */
function StatusBadge({ st = 'good', children, size = 'md', title }) {
  const m = L.STATUS[st] || L.STATUS.none;
  const sm = size === 'sm';
  return (<span title={title} style={{ display:'inline-flex', alignItems:'center', gap:sm?4:5, flexShrink:0,
    padding: sm ? '2px 6px 2px 5px' : '3px 8px 3px 6px', borderRadius:6, whiteSpace:'nowrap',
    background:`color-mix(in srgb, ${m.c} 13%, transparent)`, border:`1px solid color-mix(in srgb, ${m.c} 26%, transparent)`,
    color:m.c, fontSize:sm?10:11, fontWeight:700, letterSpacing:'0.01em' }}>
    <Icon n={m.icon} size={sm?11:13} />{children}
  </span>);
}

/* --- neutral chip --- */
function Chip({ children, tone, mono, title }) {
  const c = tone || 'rgba(255,255,255,0.055)';
  return <span title={title} style={{ display:'inline-flex', alignItems:'center', gap:4, padding:'2px 7px', borderRadius:5,
    background:c, border:'1px solid var(--border-subtle)', fontSize: 11, fontWeight:700, color:'var(--text-tertiary)',
    whiteSpace:'nowrap', fontVariantNumeric: mono?'tabular-nums':'normal' }}>{children}</span>;
}

/* --- circular / caveat badge --- */
function CircularBadge() {
  return <span style={{ display:'inline-flex', alignItems:'center', gap:4, padding:'2px 7px', borderRadius:5,
    background:'rgba(255,112,67,0.16)', border:'1px solid rgba(255,112,67,0.34)', color:'#ffb199',
    fontSize: 11, fontWeight:800, letterSpacing:'0.04em' }}>
    <Icon n="sync_problem" size={12} />Circular</span>;
}

/* --- ⓘ caveat popover --- */
function Info({ text }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  return (<span style={{ position:'relative', display:'inline-flex', verticalAlign:'middle' }}>
    <button type="button" onClick={() => setOpen(o=>!o)} onBlur={() => setOpen(false)}
      aria-label="Caveat" style={{ background:'none', border:'none', padding:0, margin:'0 0 0 4px', cursor:'pointer',
      color: open ? 'var(--x-ink)' : 'var(--text-disabled)', display:'inline-flex' }}>
      <Icon n="info" size={13} />
    </button>
    {open && <span style={{ position:'absolute', bottom:'calc(100% + 7px)', left:'50%', transform:'translateX(-50%)',
      width:264, zIndex:60, padding:'10px 12px', borderRadius:10, background:'#15171b',
      border:'1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12)', boxShadow:'0 16px 40px -14px #000',
      fontSize:11.5, lineHeight:1.5, fontWeight:500, color:'var(--text-secondary)', textAlign:'left', textWrap:'pretty' }}>{text}</span>}
  </span>);
}

/* --- stat tile --- */
function StatTile({ label, value, sub, st, tone, big, onClick, info, foot }) {
  const flat = typeof value === 'string' && /^(Not|Unverified|Mixed)/.test(value);
  return (<div className="inner-tile lab-tile" onClick={onClick} style={{ padding:'13px 15px 14px', cursor:onClick?'pointer':'default',
    display:'flex', flexDirection:'column', gap:6, minWidth:0 }}>
    <div className="label" style={{ display:'flex', alignItems:'center' }}>{label}{info && <Info text={info} />}</div>
    <div style={{ display:'flex', alignItems:'baseline', gap:8, flexWrap:'wrap' }}>
      {flat
        ? <StatusBadge st={st || 'none'}>{value}</StatusBadge>
        : <span className="font-display" style={{ fontSize: big?42:30, lineHeight:0.92, color: tone||'var(--text-primary)' }}>{value}</span>}
      {st && !flat && <StatusBadge st={st} size="sm">{{good:'OK',warning:'Watch',critical:'Critical',unverified:'Unverified',none:'—'}[st]}</StatusBadge>}
    </div>
    {sub && <div style={{ fontSize:11, fontWeight:600, color:'var(--text-muted)', lineHeight:1.45, textWrap:'pretty' }}>{sub}</div>}
    {foot}
  </div>);
}

/* --- hero meter with ticks --- */
function HeroMeter({ have, target, ticks = [] }) {
  const pct = Math.min(100, have/target*100);
  return (<div style={{ margin:'4px 0 0' }}>
    <div style={{ position:'relative', height:14, borderRadius:7, background:'rgba(255,77,28,0.10)',
      border:'1px solid rgba(255,77,28,0.16)', overflow:'hidden' }}>
      <div style={{ position:'absolute', inset:'0 auto 0 0', width:pct+'%',
        background:'linear-gradient(90deg,#c1300a,#ff4d1c)', borderRadius:'7px 4px 4px 7px',
        boxShadow:'none' }}></div>
      {ticks.map(t => <div key={t} style={{ position:'absolute', top:-1, bottom:-1, left:(t/target*100)+'%', width:1.5,
        background:'rgba(255,255,255,0.42)' }}></div>)}
    </div>
    <div style={{ position:'relative', height:15, marginTop:4 }}>
      {ticks.map(t => <span key={t} style={{ position:'absolute', left:(t/target*100)+'%', transform:'translateX(-50%)',
        fontSize: 11, fontWeight:700, color:'var(--text-muted)', fontVariantNumeric:'tabular-nums', whiteSpace:'nowrap' }}>{t}</span>)}
    </div>
  </div>);
}

/* --- lifecycle dots --- */
const LIFE_STEPS = [['processed','Processed'],['labelling','Labelling'],['finished','Finished'],['exported','Exported'],['scored','Scored']];
function LifecycleDots({ life, stale, compactMode }) {
  return (<div style={{ display:'flex', alignItems:'center', gap:0 }}>
    {LIFE_STEPS.map(([k, label], i) => {
      const s = life[k] || 'todo';
      const c = s === 'done' ? 'var(--cyan-400)' : s === 'now' ? 'var(--cyan-400)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.16)';
      return (<React.Fragment key={k}>
        {i > 0 && <span style={{ width:compactMode?9:13, height:1.5, background: s==='todo' ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.10)' : 'rgba(255,77,28,0.42)' }}></span>}
        <span title={label + ' — ' + (s==='done'?'done':s==='now'?'current':'not yet')} style={{ width:9, height:9, borderRadius:'50%', flexShrink:0,
          background: s==='done' ? c : 'transparent', border: s==='done' ? 'none' : `1.5px solid ${c}`,
          boxShadow: s==='now' ? 'none' : 'none' }}></span>
      </React.Fragment>);
    })}
    {stale && <span style={{ marginLeft:7 }}><StatusBadge st="warning" size="sm">Stale</StatusBadge></span>}
  </div>);
}

/* --- horizontal bar row (B1) --- */
function BarRow({ label, keyChip, n, max, share, r, b, low, minMark }) {
  const w = max ? (n/max*100) : 0;
  return (<div className="lab-row" style={{ display:'grid', gridTemplateColumns:(keyChip?'26px ':'')+'minmax(112px,1.1fr) minmax(120px,2fr) 96px',
    gap:10, alignItems:'center', padding:'6px 10px', borderRadius:8 }}>
    {keyChip ? <span className="kbd">{keyChip}</span> : null}
    <div style={{ display:'flex', alignItems:'center', gap:6, minWidth:0 }}>
      <span style={{ fontSize:12.5, fontWeight:700, color:'var(--text-secondary)', overflow:'hidden', textOverflow:'ellipsis', whiteSpace:'nowrap' }}>{label}</span>
      {low && <StatusBadge st="warning" size="sm" title="Below the per-class minimum">Low</StatusBadge>}
    </div>
    <div style={{ position:'relative' }}>
      <div style={{ position:'relative', height:9, background:'rgba(255,255,255,0.045)', borderRadius:2 }}>
        <div style={{ position:'absolute', inset:'0 auto 0 0', width:w+'%', minWidth: n?3:0, background:'#ff4d1c',
          borderRadius:'2px 4px 4px 2px' }}></div>
        {minMark != null && max && <div title="Per-class minimum (25)" style={{ position:'absolute', top:-3, bottom:-3,
          left:(minMark/max*100)+'%', width:1, background:'rgba(255,177,153,0.75)' }}></div>}
      </div>
      {r != null && <div style={{ display:'flex', gap:2, height:4, marginTop:3, width:w+'%', minWidth: n?3:0 }}
        title="Corner = the overlay box the labeller clicked (a track slot), not a named fighter.">
        <span style={{ flex:r||0.001, background:'var(--f-red)', borderRadius:1 }}></span>
        <span style={{ flex:b||0.001, background:'var(--f-blue)', borderRadius:1 }}></span>
      </div>}
    </div>
    <div style={{ display:'flex', alignItems:'baseline', gap:6, fontVariantNumeric:'tabular-nums' }}>
      <span style={{ fontSize:13, fontWeight:800, color:'var(--text-primary)' }}>{n}</span>
      <span style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight:600, color:'var(--text-muted)' }}>{share}</span>
    </div>
  </div>);
}

/* --- B2: per-family target breakdown — one row per real zone, shared scale --- */
const TGT = [['head', 'head'], ['body', 'body'], ['leg', 'leg'], ['ns', 'non-specific']];
function FamilyTargets() {
  const max = Math.max(...L.families.map((f) => f.total));
  const specific = L.families.filter((f) => f.ns == null);
  const nonspec = L.families.filter((f) => f.ns != null);
  const block = (f) => <div key={f.name} className="lab-fam">
    <div className="lab-fam-head">
      <span className="lab-fam-name">{f.name}</span>
      <span className="lab-fam-total">{f.total} labels</span>
      {f.total < MIN_EX && <StatusBadge st="warning" size="sm" title="Below the 25-example per-class minimum">Low</StatusBadge>}
    </div>
    {TGT.filter(([k]) => f[k] != null).map(([k, label]) => <div key={k} className="lab-zrow">
      <span className="lab-zname">{label}</span>
      <div className="lab-ztrack"><div className="lab-zbar" style={{ width: f[k] / max * 100 + '%' }}
      title={`${f.name} · ${label} — ${f[k]} labels`}></div></div>
      <span className="lab-zval">{f[k]}</span>
    </div>)}
  </div>;
  return <div>
    <div className="lab-fam-group">Specific target · head / body / leg</div>
    {specific.map(block)}
    <div className="lab-fam-group" style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>Non-specific · clinch and ground events carry no target</div>
    {nonspec.map(block)}
    <div className="lab-fam-foot">
      <span>One row per real zone · shared scale, widest = {max}</span>
      <span>107 specific · 106 non-specific · 213 total</span>
    </div>
  </div>;
}

/* --- heatmap cell --- */
function HeatCell({ v, max, low, dead, title }) {
  if (dead) return <div title="Impossible combination" style={{ height:34, borderRadius:6,
    background:'rgba(255,255,255,0.012)', border:'1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.06)' }}></div>;
  const t = max ? v/max : 0;
  return (<div title={title} style={{ position:'relative', height:34, borderRadius:6, display:'grid', placeItems:'center',
    background: v ? ramp(t) : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.02)', border:'1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05)' }}>
    <span style={{ fontSize:12, fontWeight:800, fontVariantNumeric:'tabular-nums',
      color: v ? rampInk(t) : 'var(--text-disabled)' }}>{v || 0}</span>
    {low && <span title="Below the per-class minimum" style={{ position:'absolute', top:0, right:0, width:0, height:0,
      borderTop:'7px solid #ffb199', borderLeft:'7px solid transparent', borderTopRightRadius:5 }}></span>}
  </div>);
}

/* --- 100% stacked bar --- */
function StackedBar({ segs, height = 12 }) {
  const total = segs.reduce((s,x) => s + x.v, 0) || 1;
  return (<div style={{ display:'flex', gap:2, height, borderRadius:2, overflow:'hidden' }}>
    {segs.filter(s => s.v > 0).map((s,i) => {

        {pct > 15 && height >= 12 && <span style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight:800, color:'#190500', whiteSpace:'nowrap',

  </div>);

/* --- coverage strip (C4) --- */
const LANES = [['Rounds','rounds'],['State','state'],['Swaps / excluded','spans'],['Label density','density']];
function CoverageStrip({ data, compactMode }) {
  const [hover, setHover] = useState(null);
