  return (<div style={{ position:'relative' }} onMouseLeave={() => setHover(null)}>
    {LANES.map(([label, kind]) => (
      <div key={kind} style={{ display:'grid', gridTemplateColumns:'86px 1fr', gap:10, alignItems:'center', marginBottom:5 }}>
        <span style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight:700, letterSpacing:0,

        <div style={{ position:'relative', height: kind==='density' ? 13 : 11, borderRadius:3,
          background:'rgba(255,255,255,0.028)', overflow:'hidden' }}>
          {kind === 'rounds' && data.rounds.map((r,i) => <div key={i} title={`${r.label}${r.seeded?' · seeded, unchanged':' · adjusted by hand'}`}
            onMouseEnter={() => setHover(`${r.label} · ${r.seeded?'seeded, unchanged — circular if scored':'adjusted by hand'}`)}
            style={{ position:'absolute', top:0, bottom:0, left:r.x+'%', width:r.w+'%',
              background: r.seeded ? 'rgba(245,245,244,0.16)' : 'rgba(245,245,244,0.5)',
              border: r.seeded ? '1px dashed rgba(245,245,244,0.75)' : 'none', borderRadius:3,
              display:'grid', placeItems:'center' }}>
            <span style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight:800, color:'#f5f5f4' }}>{r.label}</span></div>)}
          {kind === 'state' && data.state.map((s,i) => <div key={i} onMouseEnter={() => setHover(s.s === 'NONE' ? 'No state mark yet' : s.s)}
            title={s.s === 'NONE' ? 'No state mark yet' : s.s}
            style={{ position:'absolute', top:0, bottom:0, left:s.x+'%', width:(s.w-0.2)+'%',
              background: s.s === 'NONE' ? 'rgba(92,90,86,0.4)' : L.STATE_C[s.s], borderRadius:2 }}></div>)}
          {kind === 'spans' && <>
            {data.swaps.map((s,i) => <div key={'s'+i} onMouseEnter={() => setHover(s.open ? 'Corner swap — span still OPEN, export will skip it' : 'Corner swap')}
              title={s.open ? 'Corner swap — still open' : 'Corner swap'}
              style={{ position:'absolute', top:0, bottom:0, left:s.x+'%', width:Math.max(s.w,0.5)+'%', borderRadius:2,
                background: L.SPAN_C.swap, border: s.open ? '1px solid #9a9892' : 'none',
                boxShadow: s.open ? 'none' : 'none' }}></div>)}
            {data.excluded.map((e,i) => <div key={'e'+i} onMouseEnter={() => setHover('Excluded — ' + e.reason)} title={'Excluded — ' + e.reason}
              style={{ position:'absolute', top:0, bottom:0, left:e.x+'%', width:Math.max(e.w,0.5)+'%',
                background:L.SPAN_C.excluded, borderRadius:2,
                backgroundImage:'repeating-linear-gradient(45deg,rgba(255,255,255,0.14) 0 2px,transparent 2px 4px)' }}></div>)}
          </>}
          {kind === 'density' && <>
            {data.density.map((d,i) => <div key={i} onMouseEnter={() => setHover(`${d} strikes in this 10 s bucket`)}
              title={`${d} strikes / 10 s`}
              style={{ position:'absolute', top:0, bottom:0, left:(i/data.density.length*100)+'%', width:(100/data.density.length)+'%',
                background: d ? ramp(d/dmax) : 'transparent' }}></div>)}
            {data.gaps.map((g,i) => <div key={'g'+i} onMouseEnter={() => setHover('Unlabelled stretch — ' + g.label)}
              title={'Unlabelled stretch — ' + g.label}
              style={{ position:'absolute', top:0, bottom:0, left:g.x+'%', width:g.w+'%', borderRadius:2,
                border:'1px solid rgba(255,177,153,0.65)', background:'rgba(255,177,153,0.10)' }}></div>)}
          </>}
        </div>
      </div>))}
    <div style={{ display:'grid', gridTemplateColumns:'86px 1fr', gap:10, marginTop:7 }}>
      <span></span>
      <div style={{ display:'flex', justifyContent:'space-between', alignItems:'center', gap:10 }}>
        <span style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight:600, color:'var(--text-muted)', minHeight:14 }}>
          {hover || `${data.dur} of video · hover a lane for time, frame and counts · click opens Annotate at that frame`}</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>);
}

/* --- copy-command button + toast --- */
function CopyCmd({ cmd, label = 'Copy command', small }) {
  const [done, setDone] = useState(false);
  return (<button type="button" className="btn-glass" onClick={() => {
      try { navigator.clipboard.writeText(cmd); } catch(e) {}
      setDone(true); setTimeout(() => setDone(false), 1400);
    }} style={{ padding: small?'4px 9px':'7px 12px', fontSize: small?11:12, display:'inline-flex', alignItems:'center', gap:6 }}>
    <Icon n={done ? 'check' : 'content_copy'} size={13} />{done ? 'Copied' : label}

function Cmd({ children }) {

/* --- pill group --- */
function Pills({ opts, value, onChange, small }) {

}

/* --- table toggle wrapper: every chart can show its numbers --- */
function ChartFrame({ title, children, table, note, right }) {

function MiniTable({ head, rows }) {

  </table></div>);

/* ===== Training Lab — shared primitives ===== */
const { useState, useEffect, useRef, useMemo, useCallback } = React;
const L = window.LAB;

/* --- tiny helpers --- */
const cx = (...a) => a.filter(Boolean).join(' ');
const compact = (n) => n >= 1000 ? (n/1000).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/,'') + 'K' : String(n);
/* cyan ramp: t in 0..1 */
const ramp = (t) => {
  const c = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, t));
  return `color-mix(in srgb, #ff4d1c ${8 + c*84}%, #0e0f12)`;
};
const rampInk = (t) => t > 0.55 ? '#190500' : '#f5f5f4';

function Icon({ n, size = 16, fill, style }) {
  return <span className={cx('mi', fill && 'fill')} style={{ fontSize: size, lineHeight: 1, ...style }}>{n}</span>;
}

/* --- section label + heading --- */
function CardHead({ title, meta, children, id }) {
  return (<div style={{ display:'flex', alignItems:'flex-start', gap:14, marginBottom:16, flexWrap:'wrap' }}>
    <div style={{ flex:'1 1 260px', minWidth:0 }}>
      <div style={{ display:'flex', alignItems:'center', gap:9, marginBottom:5 }}>
        <h2 id={id} style={{ margin:0, fontSize:24, fontWeight:800, letterSpacing:'-0.03em', color:'var(--x-ink)' }}>{title}</h2>
      </div>
      {meta && <div style={{ fontSize:13, fontWeight:600, color:'var(--x-mute)', marginTop:4 }}>{meta}</div>}
    </div>
    {children && <div style={{ display:'flex', alignItems:'center', gap:8, flexWrap:'wrap' }}>{children}</div>}
  </div>);
}

/* --- status badge: 5 states, always icon + text --- */
function StatusBadge({ st = 'good', children, size = 'md', title }) {
  const m = L.STATUS[st] || L.STATUS.none;
  const sm = size === 'sm';
  return (<span title={title} style={{ display:'inline-flex', alignItems:'center', gap:sm?4:5, flexShrink:0,
    padding: sm ? '2px 6px 2px 5px' : '3px 8px 3px 6px', borderRadius:6, whiteSpace:'nowrap',
    background:`color-mix(in srgb, ${m.c} 13%, transparent)`, border:`1px solid color-mix(in srgb, ${m.c} 26%, transparent)`,
    color:m.c, fontSize:sm?10:11, fontWeight:700, letterSpacing:'0.01em' }}>
    <Icon n={m.icon} size={sm?11:13} />{children}
  </span>);
}

/* --- neutral chip --- */
function Chip({ children, tone, mono, title }) {
  const c = tone || 'rgba(255,255,255,0.055)';
  return <span title={title} style={{ display:'inline-flex', alignItems:'center', gap:4, padding:'2px 7px', borderRadius:5,
    background:c, border:'1px solid var(--border-subtle)', fontSize: 11, fontWeight:700, color:'var(--text-tertiary)',
    whiteSpace:'nowrap', fontVariantNumeric: mono?'tabular-nums':'normal' }}>{children}</span>;
}

/* --- circular / caveat badge --- */
function CircularBadge() {
  return <span style={{ display:'inline-flex', alignItems:'center', gap:4, padding:'2px 7px', borderRadius:5,
    background:'rgba(255,112,67,0.16)', border:'1px solid rgba(255,112,67,0.34)', color:'#ffb199',
    fontSize: 11, fontWeight:800, letterSpacing:'0.04em' }}>
    <Icon n="sync_problem" size={12} />Circular</span>;
}

/* --- ⓘ caveat popover --- */
function Info({ text }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  return (<span style={{ position:'relative', display:'inline-flex', verticalAlign:'middle' }}>
    <button type="button" onClick={() => setOpen(o=>!o)} onBlur={() => setOpen(false)}
      aria-label="Caveat" style={{ background:'none', border:'none', padding:0, margin:'0 0 0 4px', cursor:'pointer',
      color: open ? 'var(--x-ink)' : 'var(--text-disabled)', display:'inline-flex' }}>
      <Icon n="info" size={13} />
    </button>
    {open && <span style={{ position:'absolute', bottom:'calc(100% + 7px)', left:'50%', transform:'translateX(-50%)',
      width:264, zIndex:60, padding:'10px 12px', borderRadius:10, background:'#15171b',
      border:'1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12)', boxShadow:'0 16px 40px -14px #000',
      fontSize:11.5, lineHeight:1.5, fontWeight:500, color:'var(--text-secondary)', textAlign:'left', textWrap:'pretty' }}>{text}</span>}
  </span>);
}

/* --- stat tile --- */
function StatTile({ label, value, sub, st, tone, big, onClick, info, foot }) {
  const flat = typeof value === 'string' && /^(Not|Unverified|Mixed)/.test(value);
  return (<div className="inner-tile lab-tile" onClick={onClick} style={{ padding:'13px 15px 14px', cursor:onClick?'pointer':'default',
    display:'flex', flexDirection:'column', gap:6, minWidth:0 }}>
    <div className="label" style={{ display:'flex', alignItems:'center' }}>{label}{info && <Info text={info} />}</div>
    <div style={{ display:'flex', alignItems:'baseline', gap:8, flexWrap:'wrap' }}>

    {foot}
  </div>);
}

/* --- hero meter with ticks --- */
function HeroMeter({ have, target, ticks = [] }) {
  const pct = Math.min(100, have/target*100);
  return (<div style={{ margin:'4px 0 0' }}>
    <div style={{ position:'relative', height:14, borderRadius:7, background:'rgba(255,77,28,0.10)',

      <div style={{ position:'absolute', inset:'0 auto 0 0', width:pct+'%',
        background:'linear-gradient(90deg,#c1300a,#ff4d1c)', borderRadius:'7px 4px 4px 7px',

    </div>

      {ticks.map(t => <span key={t} style={{ position:'absolute', left:(t/target*100)+'%', transform:'translateX(-50%)',
        fontSize: 11, fontWeight:700, color:'var(--text-muted)', fontVariantNumeric:'tabular-nums', whiteSpace:'nowrap' }}>{t}</span>)}
    </div>
  </div>);
}

/* --- lifecycle dots --- */
const LIFE_STEPS = [['processed','Processed'],['labelling','Labelling'],['finished','Finished'],['exported','Exported'],['scored','Scored']];
function LifecycleDots({ life, stale, compactMode }) {
  return (<div style={{ display:'flex', alignItems:'center', gap:0 }}>
    {LIFE_STEPS.map(([k, label], i) => {
      const s = life[k] || 'todo';
      const c = s === 'done' ? 'var(--cyan-400)' : s === 'now' ? 'var(--cyan-400)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.16)';
      return (<React.Fragment key={k}>
        {i > 0 && <span style={{ width:compactMode?9:13, height:1.5, background: s==='todo' ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.10)' : 'rgba(255,77,28,0.42)' }}></span>}
        <span title={label + ' — ' + (s==='done'?'done':s==='now'?'current':'not yet')} style={{ width:9, height:9, borderRadius:'50%', flexShrink:0,
          background: s==='done' ? c : 'transparent', border: s==='done' ? 'none' : `1.5px solid ${c}`,
          boxShadow: s==='now' ? 'none' : 'none' }}></span>
      </React.Fragment>);
    })}
    {stale && <span style={{ marginLeft:7 }}><StatusBadge st="warning" size="sm">Stale</StatusBadge></span>}
  </div>);
}

/* --- horizontal bar row (B1) --- */
function BarRow({ label, keyChip, n, max, share, r, b, low, minMark }) {
  const w = max ? (n/max*100) : 0;
  return (<div className="lab-row" style={{ display:'grid', gridTemplateColumns:(keyChip?'26px ':'')+'minmax(112px,1.1fr) minmax(120px,2fr) 96px',
    gap:10, alignItems:'center', padding:'6px 10px', borderRadius:8 }}>
    {keyChip ? <span className="kbd">{keyChip}</span> : null}
    <div style={{ display:'flex', alignItems:'center', gap:6, minWidth:0 }}>

    <div style={{ position:'relative' }}>
      <div style={{ position:'relative', height:9, background:'rgba(255,255,255,0.045)', borderRadius:2 }}>

          borderRadius:'2px 4px 4px 2px' }}></div>
        {minMark != null && max && <div title="Per-class minimum (25)" style={{ position:'absolute', top:-3, bottom:-3,
          left:(minMark/max*100)+'%', width:1, background:'rgba(255,177,153,0.75)' }}></div>}
      </div>
      {r != null && <div style={{ display:'flex', gap:2, height:4, marginTop:3, width:w+'%', minWidth: n?3:0 }}
        title="Corner = the overlay box the labeller clicked (a track slot), not a named fighter.">

/* --- B2: per-family target breakdown — one row per real zone, shared scale --- */
const TGT = [['head', 'head'], ['body', 'body'], ['leg', 'leg'], ['ns', 'non-specific']];

      <div className="lab-ztrack"><div className="lab-zbar" style={{ width: f[k] / max * 100 + '%' }}
      title={`${f.name} · ${label} — ${f[k]} labels`}></div></div>
      <span className="lab-zval">{f[k]}</span>

  return <div>
    <div className="lab-fam-group">Specific target · head / body / leg</div>

    <div className="lab-fam-group" style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>Non-specific · clinch and ground events carry no target</div>
    {nonspec.map(block)}
    <div className="lab-fam-foot">

    <span style={{ fontSize:12, fontWeight:800, fontVariantNumeric:'tabular-nums',
      color: v ? rampInk(t) : 'var(--text-disabled)' }}>{v || 0}</span>
    {low && <span title="Below the per-class minimum" style={{ position:'absolute', top:0, right:0, width:0, height:0,
      borderTop:'7px solid #ffb199', borderLeft:'7px solid transparent', borderTopRightRadius:5 }}></span>}
  </div>);
}

/* --- 100% stacked bar --- */
function StackedBar({ segs, height = 12 }) {

      return (<div key={i} title={`${s.v} · ${pct.toFixed(0)}% · ${s.name}`} style={{ flex:s.v, background:s.c, borderRadius:1,
        display:'grid', placeItems:'center', minWidth:2, overflow:'hidden' }}>
        {pct > 15 && height >= 12 && <span style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight:800, color:'#190500', whiteSpace:'nowrap',
          fontVariantNumeric:'tabular-nums' }}>{s.v}</span>}
      </div>);
    })}
  </div>);
}

function Legend({ items, note }) {
  return (<div style={{ display:'flex', alignItems:'center', gap:14, flexWrap:'wrap', marginTop:10 }}>
    {items.map(i => <span key={i.name} style={{ display:'inline-flex', alignItems:'center', gap:6, fontSize: 11, fontWeight:700, color:'var(--text-tertiary)' }}>
      <span style={{ width:9, height:9, borderRadius:2, background:i.c, flexShrink:0 }}></span>{i.name}</span>)}
    {note && <span style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight:600, color:'var(--text-muted)' }}>{note}</span>}
  </div>);
}

/* --- coverage strip (C4) --- */
const LANES = [['Rounds','rounds'],['State','state'],['Swaps / excluded','spans'],['Label density','density']];
function CoverageStrip({ data, compactMode }) {
  const [hover, setHover] = useState(null);
  const dmax = Math.max(...data.density, 1);
  return (<div style={{ position:'relative' }} onMouseLeave={() => setHover(null)}>
    {LANES.map(([label, kind]) => (
      <div key={kind} style={{ display:'grid', gridTemplateColumns:'86px 1fr', gap:10, alignItems:'center', marginBottom:5 }}>
        <span style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight:700, letterSpacing:0,
          color:'rgba(255,255,255,0.28)', textAlign:'right' }}>{label}</span>
        <div style={{ position:'relative', height: kind==='density' ? 13 : 11, borderRadius:3,
          background:'rgba(255,255,255,0.028)', overflow:'hidden' }}>
          {kind === 'rounds' && data.rounds.map((r,i) => <div key={i} title={`${r.label}${r.seeded?' · seeded, unchanged':' · adjusted by hand'}`}
            onMouseEnter={() => setHover(`${r.label} · ${r.seeded?'seeded, unchanged — circular if scored':'adjusted by hand'}`)}
            style={{ position:'absolute', top:0, bottom:0, left:r.x+'%', width:r.w+'%',
              background: r.seeded ? 'rgba(245,245,244,0.16)' : 'rgba(245,245,244,0.5)',
              border: r.seeded ? '1px dashed rgba(245,245,244,0.75)' : 'none', borderRadius:3,
              display:'grid', placeItems:'center' }}>
            <span style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight:800, color:'#f5f5f4' }}>{r.label}</span></div>)}
          {kind === 'state' && data.state.map((s,i) => <div key={i} onMouseEnter={() => setHover(s.s === 'NONE' ? 'No state mark yet' : s.s)}
            title={s.s === 'NONE' ? 'No state mark yet' : s.s}
            style={{ position:'absolute', top:0, bottom:0, left:s.x+'%', width:(s.w-0.2)+'%',
              background: s.s === 'NONE' ? 'rgba(92,90,86,0.4)' : L.STATE_C[s.s], borderRadius:2 }}></div>)}
          {kind === 'spans' && <>
            {data.swaps.map((s,i) => <div key={'s'+i} onMouseEnter={() => setHover(s.open ? 'Corner swap — span still OPEN, export will skip it' : 'Corner swap')}
              title={s.open ? 'Corner swap — still open' : 'Corner swap'}
              style={{ position:'absolute', top:0, bottom:0, left:s.x+'%', width:Math.max(s.w,0.5)+'%', borderRadius:2,
                background: L.SPAN_C.swap, border: s.open ? '1px solid #9a9892' : 'none',
                boxShadow: s.open ? 'none' : 'none' }}></div>)}
            {data.excluded.map((e,i) => <div key={'e'+i} onMouseEnter={() => setHover('Excluded — ' + e.reason)} title={'Excluded — ' + e.reason}
              style={{ position:'absolute', top:0, bottom:0, left:e.x+'%', width:Math.max(e.w,0.5)+'%',
                background:L.SPAN_C.excluded, borderRadius:2,
                backgroundImage:'repeating-linear-gradient(45deg,rgba(255,255,255,0.14) 0 2px,transparent 2px 4px)' }}></div>)}
          </>}
          {kind === 'density' && <>
            {data.density.map((d,i) => <div key={i} onMouseEnter={() => setHover(`${d} strikes in this 10 s bucket`)}
              title={`${d} strikes / 10 s`}
              style={{ position:'absolute', top:0, bottom:0, left:(i/data.density.length*100)+'%', width:(100/data.density.length)+'%',
                background: d ? ramp(d/dmax) : 'transparent' }}></div>)}
            {data.gaps.map((g,i) => <div key={'g'+i} onMouseEnter={() => setHover('Unlabelled stretch — ' + g.label)}
              title={'Unlabelled stretch — ' + g.label}
              style={{ position:'absolute', top:0, bottom:0, left:g.x+'%', width:g.w+'%', borderRadius:2,
                border:'1px solid rgba(255,177,153,0.65)', background:'rgba(255,177,153,0.10)' }}></div>)}
          </>}
        </div>
      </div>))}
    <div style={{ display:'grid', gridTemplateColumns:'86px 1fr', gap:10, marginTop:7 }}>
      <span></span>
      <div style={{ display:'flex', justifyContent:'space-between', alignItems:'center', gap:10 }}>
        <span style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight:600, color:'var(--text-muted)', minHeight:14 }}>
          {hover || `${data.dur} of video · hover a lane for time, frame and counts · click opens Annotate at that frame`}</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>);
}

/* --- copy-command button + toast --- */
function CopyCmd({ cmd, label = 'Copy command', small }) {
  const [done, setDone] = useState(false);
  return (<button type="button" className="btn-glass" onClick={() => {
      try { navigator.clipboard.writeText(cmd); } catch(e) {}
      setDone(true); setTimeout(() => setDone(false), 1400);
    }} style={{ padding: small?'4px 9px':'7px 12px', fontSize: small?11:12, display:'inline-flex', alignItems:'center', gap:6 }}>
    <Icon n={done ? 'check' : 'content_copy'} size={13} />{done ? 'Copied' : label}
  </button>);
}

function Cmd({ children }) {
  return <code style={{ display:'block', padding:'8px 11px', borderRadius:8, background:'rgba(0,0,0,0.42)',
    border:'1px solid var(--border-subtle)', fontSize:11.5, fontFamily:'ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace',
    color:'#ffb199', overflowX:'auto', whiteSpace:'pre' }}>{children}</code>;
}

/* --- pill group --- */
function Pills({ opts, value, onChange, small }) {
  return (<div style={{ display:'flex', gap:4, padding:3, borderRadius:999, background:'var(--x-panel)',
    border:'1px solid var(--x-line)', flexWrap:'wrap' }}>
    {opts.map(o => <button key={o} type="button" className={cx('pill', value === o && 'active')}
      onClick={() => onChange(o)} style={{ padding: small?'4px 9px':'6px 12px', fontSize: small?11:11.5 }}>{o}</button>)}
  </div>);
}

/* --- table toggle wrapper: every chart can show its numbers --- */
function ChartFrame({ title, children, table, note, right }) {
  const [asTable, setAsTable] = useState(false);
  return (<div>
    <div style={{ display:'flex', alignItems:'center', gap:10, marginBottom:11, flexWrap:'wrap' }}>
      <div className="label" style={{ flex:1, minWidth:100 }}>{title}</div>
      {right}
      {table && <button type="button" className={cx('pill', asTable && 'active')} onClick={() => setAsTable(t=>!t)}
        style={{ padding:'3px 9px', fontSize: 11 }}>Table</button>}
    </div>
    {asTable && table ? table : children}
    {note && <p style={{ margin:'11px 0 0', fontSize:11, lineHeight:1.55, fontWeight:500, color:'var(--text-muted)', textWrap:'pretty' }}>{note}</p>}
  </div>);
}

function MiniTable({ head, rows }) {
  return (<div style={{ overflowX:'auto' }}><table className="lab-table" style={{ width:'100%', borderCollapse:'collapse' }}>
    <thead><tr>{head.map((h,i) => <th key={i} style={{ textAlign: i?'right':'left' }}>{h}</th>)}</tr></thead>
    <tbody>{rows.map((r,i) => <tr key={i}>{r.map((c,j) => <td key={j} style={{ textAlign: j?'right':'left',
      fontVariantNumeric: j?'tabular-nums':'normal' }}>{c}</td>)}</tr>)}</tbody>
  </table></div>);
}

1	import { ACTION_TO_TOOL, successForAction, TOOL_GROUPS, type Target } from '../components/annotate/taxonomy';
2	
3	/**
4	 * The subset of Annotate's palette that is actually a training class with a
5	 * reviewable clip: `needsFighter` point events minus takedown_attempt/
6	 * takedown_defended/submission_attempt/knockdown (captured but never
7	 * exported — see ai/eval/README.md's reference table) and every
8	 * `state_*` mark (a change point, not a per-event clip). Grouping mirrors
9	 * `TOOL_GROUPS` so this reads the same as the Annotate palette.
10	 */
11	export interface TrainingClass {
12	  action: string;
13	  name: string;
14	  group: string;
15	}
16	
17	const NOT_A_CLASS = new Set([
18	  'takedown_attempt',
19	  'takedown_defended',
20	  'submission_attempt',
21	  'knockdown',
22	]);
23	
24	export const TRAINING_CLASSES: TrainingClass[] = TOOL_GROUPS.flatMap((g) =>
25	  g.items
26	    .filter((it) => it.needsFighter && !NOT_A_CLASS.has(it.action))
27	    .map((it) => ({ action: it.action, name: it.name, group: g.group })),
28	);
29	
30	export const TRAINING_ACTIONS = new Set(TRAINING_CLASSES.map((c) => c.action));
31	
32	export const CLASS_BY_ACTION: Record<string, TrainingClass> =
33	  Object.fromEntries(TRAINING_CLASSES.map((c) => [c.action, c]));
34	
35	/**
36	 * What `target`/`success` should become when a Training Data QA reviewer
37	 * retypes an event to `newAction` (EventReview's "Type" dropdown) — mirrors
38	 * what Annotate's own palette derives the moment a tool is first pressed
39	 * (`logTool()` in Annotate.tsx): a `fixedTarget` class always takes its own
40	 * fixed target, a `hasTarget` class keeps whatever head/body target the
41	 * event already had (defaulting to head), everything else has no target.
42	 * `success` is always `successForAction(newAction)`, same as a fresh label —
43	 * this is what keeps e.g. a retyped `takedown_landed` from silently ending
44	 * up with `success=null`, which nothing else in the app ever produces.
45	 */
46	export function reclassifyPayload(
47	  newAction: string,
48	  currentTarget: string | null,
49	): { action: string; target: Target | null; success: boolean | null } {
50	  const tool = ACTION_TO_TOOL[newAction];
51	  const target: Target | null = tool?.fixedTarget
52	    ? tool.fixedTarget
53	    : tool?.hasTarget
54	      ? (currentTarget === 'body' ? 'body' : 'head')
55	      : null;
56	  return { action: newAction, target, success: successForAction(newAction) };
57	}

## Done — Training Data QA redesign implemented

Pulled `Training Data.html` + its assets (`td-app.jsx`, `td-player.jsx`, `td-data.js`, `lab-parts.jsx`) and compared against the real `TrainingDataQA.tsx` tree. Since the shared brand tokens and primitives (`.pill`, `.btn-glass`, `.glass`, `.label`, `.icon-btn`) were already reskinned in the Annotate pass, most of this page inherited the new look for free — the remaining work was structural/typographic parity plus cleaning up leftover hardcoded cyan.

**Files changed:**
- `src/pages/TrainingDataQA.tsx` — hero restyle (eyebrow + big display heading, bigger tabular-num stats), de-hardcoded the last two cyan gradients, un-overrode breadcrumb pill radii
- `src/components/trainingData/ClassGrid.tsx` — bigger card typography, added a real keyboard-shortcut chip per class (derived from the Annotate palette, not fabricated)
- `src/components/trainingData/EventTable.tsx` — rounder filter/row containers with hover state, added a second filter dimension by fight (real data already on `QAEvent`)
- `src/components/trainingData/EventReview.tsx` — pill-shaped bigger Confirm/Decline buttons (kept the real green/red semantic — better than the mockup's monochrome treatment), dropped uppercase micro-labels to match the new `.label` convention, added a **Labeller** row surfacing the real `Event.labeler` field the UI wasn't showing yet
- `src/components/trainingData/ClipPlayer.tsx`, `VerdictBadge.tsx` — token cleanup, `.icon-btn` for transport buttons
- `src/utils/trainingDataTaxonomy.ts` — added `TrainingClass.key`
- `src/index.css` — `.td-class`/`.td-row` hover rule

**Deliberately dropped from the mockup** (per your "current app is source of truth" instruction, and matching what `frontend/CLAUDE.md` already documents as an intentional choice): the synthesized skeleton-pose clip thumbnails, the fabricated "automatic checks" defect panel, per-event "keypoint confidence," and the "Reset my review" button — none of these have a real backing data source or endpoint; `ClipPlayer` already correctly plays the real video instead of a synthesized animation.

**Verified:** `tsc --noEmit` clean, `vite build` succeeds, eslint clean on every touched file, grep sweep confirms no old cyan hex remains. Same caveat as before — no browser tool in this session, so I couldn't screenshot it; your dev server at `:5173` has it live now.

/* ===== Training Lab — sections E · F · G, reference drawer, component sheet ===== */

/* ---------- E · Pipeline accuracy — one fixture, every pipeline version ---------- */
const FIXTURES = Object.keys(L.evalRuns);

function SectionE() {
  const [fight, setFight] = useState(FIXTURES[0]);
  const fx = L.evalRuns[fight];
  const runs = fx.runs;
  const [i, setI] = useState(runs.length - 1);
  const idx = Math.min(i, runs.length - 1);
  const run = runs[idx];
  const prev = idx > 0 ? runs[idx - 1] : null;
  const pick = (f) => { setFight(f); setI(L.evalRuns[f].runs.length - 1); };
  const delta = prev ? +(run.f1 - prev.f1).toFixed(1) : null;

  return <section className="lab-sec" id="sec-e">
    <div className="glass lab-card" data-comment-anchor="0bf4e4e460-div-7-5">
      <CardHead title="Pipeline accuracy" meta={`${fight} · ${fx.labelled} · scored at tolerance ±0.25 s (±12 f at 50 fps)`}>
        <Pills opts={FIXTURES} value={fight} onChange={pick} small />
      </CardHead>

      <div className="label" style={{ marginBottom: 9, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center' }}>Pipeline version
        <Info text="Every version that has been run over this fight, oldest first. The newest run is the latest AI pass and is selected by default." /></div>
      <div className="lab-vertrack">
        {runs.map((r, n) => <button key={r.sha} type="button" onClick={() => setI(n)}
        className={cx('lab-verchip', n === idx && 'on')}>
          <code>{r.sha}</code><span>{r.date}</span>
          {r.current && <span className="lab-verdot" title="Latest AI-processed run"></span>}
        </button>)}
      </div>

      <div className="lab-e1" style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
        <div className="inner-tile" style={{ padding: '16px 18px' }}>
          <div className="label" style={{ marginBottom: 9, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center' }}>Strike detection F1
            <Info text="This fight's predictions matched against its manual labels. TP/FP/FN from one fixture — not pooled." /></div>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'baseline', gap: 10, marginBottom: 10, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
            <span className="font-display" style={{ fontSize: 52, lineHeight: 0.88, color: 'var(--cyan-400)' }}>{run.f1}%</span>
            <span style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--text-tertiary)', fontVariantNumeric: 'tabular-nums' }}>P {run.p}% · R {run.r}%</span>
          </div>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
            <Chip mono>TP {run.tp}</Chip><Chip mono>FP {run.fp}</Chip><Chip mono>FN {run.fn}</Chip>
            <Chip mono>{fx.gt} labelled</Chip><Chip mono>{run.pred} predicted</Chip>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="inner-tile" style={{ padding: '13px 15px' }}>
          <div className="label" style={{ marginBottom: 9 }}>Change</div>

const SEC_INDEX = [['sec-a', 'A', 'Overview'], ['sec-b', 'B', 'Annotated events'], ['sec-d', 'D', 'Fights'], ['sec-e', 'E', 'Pipeline accuracy'], ['sec-f', 'F', 'Pipeline health']];

function Header() {
  const NAVL = [['Analysis', 'Analysis Player.html'], ['Library', '#'], ['Annotate', 'Annotate.html'], ['Lab', 'Training Lab.html'], ['Data QA', 'Training Data.html']];
  return <header className="app-header">
    <a className="logo" href="Analysis Player.html">fightlytics</a>
    <nav className="app-nav" style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 2 }}>
      {NAVL.map(([l, h]) => <a key={l} className={'nav-link' + (l === 'Lab' ? ' active' : '')} href={h}>{l}</a>)}
    </nav>
    <span className="header-spacer"></span>
    <a className="btn-upload" href="Analysis Player.html" style={{ height: 36, padding: '0 16px', fontSize: 13 }}>Upload a fight</a>
    <button type="button" className="icon-btn" title="Account"><Icon n="person" size={20} /></button>
  </header>;
}

function FilterRow({ scope, setScope, period, setPeriod }) {
  const [fOpen, setFOpen] = useState(false);
  const [picked, setPicked] = useState(['DRAGOJEVIC vs HONDA', 'VITASOVIC vs STOSIC', 'MILIDRAGOVIC vs MOOSMAN']);
  const allFights = L.ledger.map((f) => f.fight);
  return <div className="lab-filter">
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
      <span style={{ position: 'relative' }} data-comment-anchor="ecd09be7aa-div-303-11">
        <button type="button" className="btn-glass" onClick={() => setFOpen((o) => !o)}
        style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 7, padding: '7px 11px' }}>
          <Icon n="filter_list" size={14} /><span>{picked.length} of {allFights.length} fights</span><Icon n="expand_more" size={15} />
        </button>
        {fOpen && <div className="lab-menu" style={{ minWidth: 250 }}>
          {allFights.map((f) => <button key={f} type="button" className="lab-menu-item"
          onClick={() => setPicked((p) => p.includes(f) ? p.filter((x) => x !== f) : [...p, f])}>
            <Icon n={picked.includes(f) ? 'check_box' : 'check_box_outline_blank'} size={15}
            style={{ color: picked.includes(f) ? 'var(--x-ink)' : 'var(--text-disabled)' }} />{f}
          </button>)}
        </div>}
      </span>
      <span style={{ width: 1, height: 22, background: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)' }}></span>
      <Pills opts={['All time', 'Last 7 days', 'Last 30 days']} value={period} onChange={setPeriod} small />
    </div>
    <span style={{ flex: 1 }}></span>
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 9 }}>
      <span style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600, color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>Refreshed 2 min ago</span>
      <button type="button" className="icon-btn" title="Refresh — the previous render stays at reduced opacity"
      style={{ width: 34, height: 34 }}><Icon n="refresh" size={17} /></button>
    </div>
  </div>;
}

function SectionIndex({ active, go }) {
  return <nav className="lab-index" aria-label="Sections">
    <div className="lab-index-title">Sections</div>
    <ul className="lab-index-list">
      {SEC_INDEX.map(([id, letter, label]) =>
      <li key={id}>
          <a href={'#' + id} className={cx('lab-index-link', active === id && 'on')}
        onClick={(e) => {e.preventDefault();go(id);}} aria-current={active === id ? 'true' : undefined}>
            <span className="lab-index-label">{label}</span>
          </a>
        </li>)}
    </ul>
  </nav>;
}

/* ---------- App ---------- */
function App() {
  const [scope, setScope] = useState('All labelled');
  const [period, setPeriod] = useState('All time');
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(52);
  const [drawer, setDrawer] = useState(false);
  const [active, setActive] = useState('sec-a');

  const go = useCallback((id) => {
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (!el) return;
    const y = el.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.pageYOffset - 76;
    window.scrollTo({ top: y, behavior: 'smooth' });
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const onScroll = () => {
      let cur = 'sec-a';
      SEC_INDEX.forEach(([id]) => {
        const el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el && el.getBoundingClientRect().top < 160) cur = id;
      });
      setActive(cur);
    };
    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
    onScroll();
    return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll);
  }, []);

  return <>
    <Header />
    <div className="lab-page">
      <div className="lab-title-row">
        <div style={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
          <span className="eyebrow">Lab</span>
          <h1 className="font-display lab-h1">Training lab.</h1>
          <p className="lab-sub">What the model learns from, and how well it scores.</p>
        </div>
        <span style={{ flex: 1 }}></span>
        <a className="btn-glass" href="Training Data.html" style={{ height: 44 }}>Review training data<Icon n="arrow_forward" size={16} /></a>
      </div>
      <FilterRow scope={scope} setScope={setScope} period={period} setPeriod={setPeriod} />
      <div className="lab-body">
        <SectionIndex active={active} go={go} />
        <div className="lab-main">
          <SectionA go={go} />
          <SectionB openDrawer={() => setDrawer(true)} />
          <SectionD expanded={expanded} setExpanded={setExpanded} />
          <SectionE />
          <SectionF />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <Drawer open={drawer} onClose={() => setDrawer(false)} />
  </>;
}

ReactDOM.createRoot(document.getElementById('root')).render(<App />);
</untrusted-project-content>

<untrusted-project-content path="Training Lab.html" etag="1790578875786465">
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8"/>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"/>
<title>Fightlytics — Training Lab</title>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="assets/brand.css"/>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Material+Symbols+Outlined:opsz,wght,FILL,GRAD@20..48,100..700,0..1,-50..200"/>
<style>
.lab-page{position:relative;z-index:1;max-width:1440px;margin:0 auto;padding:36px 32px 96px}
.lab-title-row{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:16px;margin-bottom:26px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.lab-h1{font-size:clamp(40px,5.2vw,72px);margin:12px 0 0;color:var(--x-ink)}
.lab-sub{margin:12px 0 0;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:var(--x-mute)}
.lab-filter{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:10px 14px;margin-bottom:22px;border-radius:22px;background:var(--x-panel);border:1px solid var(--x-line)}
.lab-body{display:grid;grid-template-columns:172px minmax(0,1fr);gap:22px;align-items:start}
.lab-main{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;min-width:0}
.lab-sec{animation:fade-up .6s var(--ease) both}
.lab-sec:nth-child(1){animation-delay:0s}.lab-sec:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.08s}.lab-sec:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.16s}
.lab-sec:nth-child(4){animation-delay:.24s}.lab-sec:nth-child(5){animation-delay:.32s}.lab-sec:nth-child(6){animation-delay:.4s}
.lab-sec:nth-child(7){animation-delay:.48s}.lab-sec:nth-child(8){animation-delay:.56s}
.lab-card{padding:26px 28px 28px}
/* section index — traditional nav */
.lab-index{position:sticky;top:74px}
.lab-index-title{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:0;color:var(--x-mute);padding:0 0 8px 2px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);margin-bottom:6px}
.lab-index-list{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1px}
.lab-index-link{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:999px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--x-mute);border:1px solid transparent;transition:color .12s,background .12s,border-color .12s}
.lab-index-link:hover{color:var(--text-secondary);background:rgba(255,255,255,0.035);text-decoration:none}
.lab-index-link.on{color:var(--x-ink);border-color:var(--x-line-2);background:var(--x-panel-2)}
.lab-index-letter{font-size:11px;font-weight:800;color:var(--text-disabled);min-width:9px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.lab-index-link.on .lab-index-letter{color:var(--cyan-400)}
.lab-index-label{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
/* A */
.lab-grid-a{display:grid;grid-template-columns:5fr 7fr;gap:14px}
.lab-tiles{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));grid-auto-rows:1fr;gap:12px}
.lab-tile{transition:border-color .12s,background .12s}
.lab-tile:hover{border-color:var(--x-line-2)}
/* B */
.lab-b-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:8fr 4fr;gap:22px}
.lab-row:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,0.035)}
.lab-multiples{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(210px,1fr));gap:11px}
.lab-heat-head,.lab-heat-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:76px repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr)) 42px;gap:5px;margin-bottom:5px}
.lab-heat-row>span:first-child{align-self:center}
.lab-heat-col{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.28);text-align:center}
/* B2 family targets */
.lab-fam-group{font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:0;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.26);margin-bottom:9px}
.lab-fam{padding:11px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.045)}
.lab-fam:last-of-type{border-bottom:none}
.lab-fam-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:8px}
.lab-fam-name{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:800;color:var(--text-primary)}
.lab-fam-total{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text-muted);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.lab-zrow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:64px minmax(0,1fr) 30px;gap:9px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:4px}
.lab-zname{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text-muted);text-align:right}
.lab-ztrack{height:8px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.035);border-radius:2px}
.lab-zbar{height:100%;background:#ff4d1c;border-radius:2px 3px 3px 2px;min-width:2px}
.lab-zval{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:800;color:var(--text-secondary);text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.lab-fam-foot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:12px;padding-top:9px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text-muted)}
/* C */
.lab-c-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px}
.lab-callout{display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:flex-start;padding:12px 16px;border-radius:18px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.028);border:1px solid var(--border-subtle);font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.6;font-weight:500;color:var(--text-secondary);text-wrap:pretty}
/* D ledger */
.lab-llist{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.lab-lcard{border:1px solid var(--border-subtle);border-radius:18px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.022);overflow:hidden;transition:border-color .12s,background .12s}
.lab-lcard:hover{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,0.14)}
.lab-lcard.open{border-color:var(--x-line-2);background:var(--x-panel-2)}
.lab-lhead{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:10px 14px;align-items:center;padding:12px 14px;cursor:pointer}
.lab-lmeta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:7px;margin-top:6px}
.lab-lmetrics{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px 22px;padding:0 14px 13px}
.lab-lm .k{font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:0;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.26);margin-bottom:3px;white-space:nowrap}
.lab-lm .v{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;color:var(--text-primary);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.lab-lm .v .dash{color:var(--text-disabled)}
.lab-vertrack{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px}
.lab-verchip{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.03);border:1px solid var(--border-glass);cursor:pointer;transition:background .12s,border-color .12s}
.lab-verchip:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,0.06)}
.lab-verchip.on{background:var(--x-panel-2);border-color:var(--x-line-2)}
.lab-verchip code{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--x-ink)}
.lab-verchip span{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text-muted)}
.lab-verdot{position:absolute;top:-3px;right:-3px;width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:#ff4d1c;border:1px solid #0e0f12}
.lab-erun{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(178px,1fr));gap:11px}
.lab-ledger{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;min-width:1180px}
.lab-ledger th,.lab-ledger td.num{white-space:nowrap}
.lab-ledger th{position:sticky;top:58px;z-index:5;background:#0e0f12;padding:9px 10px;text-align:left;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:0;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.32);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);white-space:nowrap}
.lab-ledger th.num,.lab-ledger td.num{text-align:right}
.lab-ledger td{padding:10px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04);font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text-tertiary);vertical-align:middle}
.lab-ledger td b{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:800;color:var(--text-primary);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.lab-ledger td .dash{color:var(--text-disabled)}
.lab-lrow{cursor:pointer;transition:background .12s}
.lab-lrow:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,0.035)}
.lab-lrow.open{background:rgba(255,77,28,0.045)}
.lab-lexp>td{padding:0!important;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07)}
.lab-ibtn{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:999px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.04);border:1px solid var(--border-glass);color:var(--text-tertiary);cursor:pointer;flex-shrink:0}
.lab-ibtn:hover{background:var(--x-panel-2);color:var(--x-ink)}
.lab-exp-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:20px}
.lab-dl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:5px 12px;margin:0}
.lab-dl dt{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.26);align-self:center}
.lab-dl dd{margin:0;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text-secondary)}
/* tables */
.lab-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse}
.lab-table th{padding:7px 10px;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:0;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.3);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);white-space:nowrap}
.lab-table td{padding:8px 10px;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text-tertiary);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04)}
.lab-table td.num{text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.lab-ref td{vertical-align:top}
/* E */
.lab-e0-pointers{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:12px;margin-top:14px}
.lab-pointer{transition:border-color .12s}
.lab-pointer:hover{border-color:var(--x-line-2)}
.lab-e1{display:grid;grid-template-columns:5fr 3.5fr 3.5fr;gap:12px}
.lab-e3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(170px,1fr));gap:11px}
.lab-e4{display:grid;grid-template-columns:7fr 5fr;gap:22px}
.lab-e6{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}

6	model, which is blocked on measured accuracy (see memory
7	`fight-ai-tracking-rewrite-plan`). You now have your first real fixtures —
8	a hand-labelled reference fight plus fight 60 and fight 62 (fight 62 having
9	gone through the first pipeline version) — and plan to re-upload the same
10	source video through each new pipeline version to track whether it's actually
11	improving. Today that comparison only exists as CLI output
12	(`python -m eval.cli score <video>`) with no persistence and no UI.
13

15	app", `Training Lab.html` + `assets/lab-*.jsx`), covering seven sections
16	(labelled-data inventory, spans/coverage, a fight ledger, pipeline accuracy,
17	label-free health checks, label quality). Its brief
18	(`uploads/TRAINING_LAB_BRIEF.md`) is unusually rigorous: it encodes "honesty
19	rules" written specifically against this project's history of being misled by
20	circular or misleading metrics (round IoU scored against auto-seeded spans,
21	corner read-back that's ~100% by construction, EasyOCR confidence noise) —
22	these map directly onto memories already in this project
23	(`fight-ai-eval-labels-are-circular`, `label-events-corner-is-box-not-person`,
24	`corner-accuracy-blind-on-ground`, `easyocr-confidence-is-noise`).
25	
26	**Only Section E ("Pipeline accuracy") is in scope for this plan.** Sections
27	A–D/F/G need labelled-data volume and infrastructure (label-event counts,
28	span coverage strips, sanity-check history) that doesn't exist yet — building
29	them now would be UI over data nobody has. Section E is exactly what your
30	current 2-3 fixtures can already populate, and directly serves your stated
31	goal of comparing pipeline versions over time.
32	
33	The chosen data-storage approach: persist every scoring run to a new DB
34	table (`eval_runs`) rather than reading `ai/eval/baselines/*.json` on demand,
35	so the version-trend chart has real queryable history as you accumulate runs.
36	
37	## A real gap this plan has to close first
38	
39	`backend/CLAUDE.md` documents the intended workflow explicitly: accuracy is
40	measured by uploading the same source video a second time as a **new**
41	`fights` row (`purpose='ai_labeled'`) and scoring its predictions against the
42	**first** upload's labels (`purpose='reference'`) — two different `fight_id`s,
43	never re-processing a labelled fight in place.
44	
45	But `ai/eval/cli.py`'s `score` command takes one `video` argument and uses it
46	for **both** `FightLabels.for_video(args.video)` and
47	`load_predictions(args.video)` (`cli.py:143-144`) — both resolve through
48	`lookup_fight()` keyed on `fights.video_path`/filename stem
49	(`predictions.py:71-103`, `labels_db.py:69-72`). Since re-uploading the same
50	file gets a renamed path (`fights.py`'s `_unique_path` on collision), the two
51	fight IDs don't share a lookup key today. **There is currently no way to score
52	one fight's predictions against a different fight's labels.** This has to be
53	fixed before any cross-version comparison is possible — it's not optional
54	scope, it's the actual blocker.
55	
56	## Plan
57	
58	### Phase 0 — close the cross-fight-id scoring gap (`ai/eval/`)
59	
60	- Add `build_labels_by_fight_id(fight_id)` alongside `labels_db.build_labels()`
61	  and `load_predictions_by_fight_id(fight_id)` alongside
62	  `predictions.load_predictions()` — both already resolve a fight row first
63	  and then read by `fight_id`; skip the video-string lookup, take the id
64	  directly.
65	- Add a `score-pair` subcommand to `ai/eval/cli.py` (alongside `score`/
66	  `agreement`, following their existing arg-parser blocks):
67	  `python -m eval.cli score-pair --labels-fight-id <ref> --predictions-fight-id <scored> [--tolerance-override S] --json <path>`.
68	  Reuses `score.score()` unchanged — only the label/prediction loading
69	  differs.
70	- Verify by hand against your real fixtures: run it with the reference
71	  fight's id and fight 62's id and confirm you get a sane `Report`.
72	
73	### Phase 1 — persistence
74	
75	- **New Alembic migration** in `db/alembic/versions/` (this repo has a real
76	  Alembic setup at `db/alembic/` — do **not** rely on `Base.metadata.create_all`,
77	  follow the existing revision-chain convention, e.g.
78	  `e6f7a8b9c0d1_add_purpose_to_fights.py`) creating `eval_runs`:
79	  - `id`, `reference_fight_id` (FK → `fights.id`, cascade), `scored_fight_id`
80	    (FK → `fights.id`, cascade), `git_sha`, `constants_sha256`,
81	    `tolerance_frames`, `scored_minutes`, `report` (JSONB — the exact
82	    `report` sub-object `report_io.save_report()` already produces via
83	    `dataclasses.asdict()` + `_confusion_to_json()`, so DB rows and the
84	    checked-in `ai/eval/baselines/*.json` files are byte-shape-identical),
85	    `generated_at`, `triggered_by` (nullable).
86	  - Index on `(reference_fight_id, generated_at)` for the fixture-table and
87	    trend-chart queries.
88	  - No uniqueness constraint — append-only log, multiple runs per version
89	    allowed (matches the append-only spirit of the baseline JSON files).
90	  - **Don't normalize the report into columns.** Every E1–E9 panel needs a
91	    different slice of a nested structure that changes shape as `score.py`
92	    evolves; a JSONB blob plus the handful of columns actually needed for
93	    filtering (`git_sha`, `tolerance_frames`, `generated_at`, the two FKs) is
94	    the right amount of structure.
95	- `save_eval_run_db()` — new function in `ai/eval/report_io.py`, mirroring the
96	  existing envelope logic, opening a session the same way `ai/database.py`'s
97	  `set_fight_state`/`set_video_check` do. Wire a `--write-db` flag onto
98	  `score-pair`.
99	- Run `score-pair --write-db` by hand once for your reference/fight-62 pair
100	  to get the first real row in `eval_runs`.
101	
102	### Phase 2 — backend API
103	
104	Follow the existing thin-router → service → model layering exactly
105	(`api/routes/fights.py` → `app/services/*.py` → `app/models/*.py`, registered
106	in `main.py`).
107	
108	- `backend/app/models/eval_run.py` — `EvalRun` SQLAlchemy model (mirrors the
109	  migration) + `EvalRunResponse`/`EvalRunSummary` (list endpoints return the
110	  summary, without the full `report` blob) Pydantic models.
111	- `backend/app/services/eval_run_service.py`:
112	  - `list_fixtures()` — every `fights` row with `purpose='reference'` and
113	    `labeled_at IS NOT NULL`, each with its latest `eval_runs` row (or
114	    `is_measurable=False` if none exist — this is E0).
115	  - `list_runs(reference_fight_id, scored_fight_id=None)` — E2/E8 source.
116	  - `get_run(id)` — full report for E3–E9 drill-down.
117	  - `create_run(reference_fight_id, scored_fight_id, tolerance_secs=None)` —
118	    validates `scored_fight_id`'s fight is `purpose='ai_labeled'` and
119	    `state='completed'`, `reference_fight_id`'s fight is `purpose='reference'`
120	    and `labeled_at IS NOT NULL`, then `subprocess.run`s
121	    `eval.cli score-pair --write-db` **synchronously** (this is a DB read +
122	    an in-memory Hungarian-matching pass, not a video-decode job — no
123	    polling/SSE needed unlike `pipeline_runner.run_pipeline_async`), returns
124	    the new row.
125	- `backend/app/api/routes/eval_runs.py` — new top-level router (spans two
126	  fight IDs, not naturally nested under `/fights/`):
127	  - `GET /eval-runs/fixtures`
128	  - `GET /eval-runs/?reference_fight_id=&scored_fight_id=`
129	  - `GET /eval-runs/{id}`
130	  - `POST /eval-runs/` (body: `reference_fight_id`, `scored_fight_id`,
131	    optional `tolerance_secs`)
132	- Register in `backend/app/main.py` with `app.include_router(...,
133	  prefix="/eval-runs")`, same three-line pattern as the existing routers.
134	
135	**E0 "not measurable" detection**: a fixture (a `reference_fight_id`) is
136	"not measurable yet" when it has zero `eval_runs` rows — not when no
137	`ai_labeled` fight exists anywhere (that would false-positive on unrelated
138	fights). The E0 empty-state copy should show the real two-step flow: upload
139	the source video again as `purpose=ai_labeled`, then either click "Run
140	scoring" (`POST /eval-runs/`) or run `score-pair --write-db` by hand.
141	
142	### Phase 3 — round-circularity guard (needed for E7)
143	
144	`event_service._ensure_round_events_seeded` (`event_service.py:36-70`) copies
145	`rounds.start_frame`/`end_frame` verbatim into a `source='label',
146	kind='round'` `fight_events` row the first time it's fetched, and no column
147	anywhere records whether a labeller later touched it. The only honest signal
148	available is exact-match:
149	
150	```
151	is_seeded_unverified = (label_event.frame == round.start_frame
152	                         and label_event.end_frame == round.end_frame)
153	```
154	
155	This has a known false-negative (a labeller who reviewed and left it
156	unchanged looks identical to one who never opened it) — accept it, since it
157	errs toward showing more "unverified" rounds, never fewer, matching the
158	honesty rule's bias.
159	
160	Implementation: compute this in `labels_db.build_labels()` (which already
161	reads both `fight_events` and can join `rounds`), stamp it onto each `Round`
162	label, thread it through `score_rounds()` into a new `seeded: bool` field on
163	`RoundScore.matched` entries. The frontend renders "Seeded — not verified"
164	instead of an IoU % when true.
165	
166	### Phase 4 — frontend
167	
168	- New route `/accuracy` in `frontend/src/App.tsx` (alongside the existing
169	  four routes at `App.tsx:42-46`) → `frontend/src/pages/PipelineAccuracy.tsx`.
170	- New nav entry in `frontend/src/components/Header.tsx`.
171	- New folder `frontend/src/components/accuracy/`, mirroring the existing
172	  `player/`/`annotate/` convention. Component-to-design mapping:
173	
174	  | Design piece | Component | Reuse |
175	  |---|---|---|
176	  | Provenance line | `ProvenanceLine.tsx` | new (trivial) |
177	  | E0 not-measurable | `NotMeasurable.tsx` | new — copyable CLI command |
178	  | E1 headline | `HeadlineF1.tsx` | reuse `AccGauge` (F1 ring) + `MiniStat` (P/R/TP/FP/FN tiles); new `ChangeTile.tsx` for vs-previous/vs-baseline |
179	  | E2 fixture table | `FixtureTable.tsx` | new |
180	  | E3 classification | `ClassificationBreakdown.tsx` | reuse `SegBar`; new `CircularBadge`/`NotMeasuredBadge` (shared) |
181	  | E4 family confusion | `ConfusionHeatmap.tsx` | new, parametrized so E6 reuses it for the 3×3 state matrix |
182	  | E5 timing | `OffsetDotStrip.tsx` | new (dot strip, not `PaceChart`'s area/line shape — borrow its SVG/viewBox scaffolding only) |
183	  | E6 fight state | `StateDumbbell.tsx` + shared `ConfusionHeatmap` | new dumbbell |
184	  | E7 rounds | `RoundsCheck.tsx` | new — "Seeded — not verified" via `NotMeasuredBadge` |
185	  | E8 version trend | `VersionTrendChart.tsx` | new — needs hollow markers (constants changed) + line-break-with-note (tolerance/fixture-set changed), which `PaceChart` has no equivalent of |
186	  | E9 worst misses/FPs | `WorstMissesList.tsx`, `WorstFPList.tsx` | new |
187	
188	- **Colors**: reuse `frontend/src/utils/eventTaxonomy.ts`'s
189	  `colorForAction`/`iconForAction` for family/action rows — build a pseudo
190	  action string (`` `${family}_${target}` ``) since eval's `Strike.family`/
191	  `.target` are decomposed while `eventTaxonomy.ts` keys off pipeline action
192	  strings. **Fight-state colors must NOT copy `AnnotationTimeline.tsx`'s
193	  scheme** (`GROUND → var(--f-red)`, confirmed at `AnnotationTimeline.tsx:379`)
194	  — that's the red-corner collision the design brief calls out (memory
195	  `frontend-palette-collisions`). Use a local mapping in the new components:
196	  `STRIKING: var(--cyan-600)`, `CLINCH: var(--orange-400)`,
197	  `GROUND: var(--purple-600)` — confirmed these tokens already exist in
198	  `frontend/src/index.css` (`--cyan-600: #0099b0`, `--orange-400: #ff7043`,
199	  `--purple-600: #7c3aed`), so this needs no new CSS variables. Do not touch
200	  `AnnotationTimeline.tsx` itself — out of scope.
201	- **Visual system**: confirmed the real `index.css` already matches the
202	  mockup's `assets/brand.css` near-verbatim (same glass-card tokens, same
203	  `--f-red`/`--f-blue`/`--accent` values) — no new design tokens needed,
204	  reuse the existing dark glass-card system as-is.
205	- **E9 click-through**: no `?frame=` param support exists on `Player.tsx`
206	  today. Stub the click as `navigate(`/fights/${scored_fight_id}`)` with no
207	  auto-seek for the first cut; add `useSearchParams`-based seeking as a
208	  fast-follow, not a blocker.
209	
210	### Sequencing
211	
212	1. **Phase 0** (`score-pair`) — unblocks getting a first real number today,
213	   no UI required. Confirm which of "fight 60"/"fight 62" is your
214	   `purpose='reference'` fixture vs. the `purpose='ai_labeled'` scored fight
215	   before running it (the workflow needs one of each per fixture).
216	2. **Phase 1 + 2** (migration, persistence, minimal API) — first row in
217	   `eval_runs`.
218	3. **Phase 4, cut down to E0/E1/E2/E8 only** — demoable version-comparison
219	   view, even with just 1-2 trend points initially. This is the part that
220	   directly answers "did the last pipeline change help or hurt."
221	4. **Phase 3 + remaining Phase 4** (E3, E4/E6 heatmap, E5, E7, E9) — the
222	   deeper breakdown, once the above is validated against your real data.
223	
224	## Verification
225	
226	- `python -m eval.cli score-pair --labels-fight-id <ref> --predictions-fight-id <scored> --json /tmp/run.json` produces a report whose numbers match hand-checking a few strikes in the Annotate/Player view.
227	- After the migration: `eval_runs` table exists (`\d eval_runs` in psql), a `--write-db` run inserts one row.
228	- `GET /eval-runs/fixtures`, `GET /eval-runs/?reference_fight_id=...`, `GET /eval-runs/{id}` return the expected shapes via `curl`/the FastAPI `/docs` page.
229	- `/accuracy` in the browser: shows E0 for a fixture with no runs, E1/E2/E8 populated for the reference/fight-62 pair after Phase 1's manual run, matching the numbers `score-pair`'s CLI output printed.
230	- Re-run `score-pair --write-db` a second time (simulating a new pipeline version) and confirm E8's trend chart picks up the second point.

- `backend/app/api/routes/eval_runs.py` — new top-level router (spans two
  fight IDs, not naturally nested under `/fights/`):
  - `GET /eval-runs/fixtures`
  - `GET /eval-runs/?reference_fight_id=&scored_fight_id=`
  - `GET /eval-runs/{id}`
  - `POST /eval-runs/` (body: `reference_fight_id`, `scored_fight_id`,
    optional `tolerance_secs`)
- Register in `backend/app/main.py` with `app.include_router(...,
  prefix="/eval-runs")`, same three-line pattern as the existing routers.

**E0 "not measurable" detection**: a fixture (a `reference_fight_id`) is
"not measurable yet" when it has zero `eval_runs` rows — not when no
`ai_labeled` fight exists anywhere (that would false-positive on unrelated
fights). The E0 empty-state copy should show the real two-step flow: upload
the source video again as `purpose=ai_labeled`, then either click "Run
scoring" (`POST /eval-runs/`) or run `score-pair --write-db` by hand.

### Phase 3 — round-circularity guard (needed for E7)

`event_service._ensure_round_events_seeded` (`event_service.py:36-70`) copies
`rounds.start_frame`/`end_frame` verbatim into a `source='label',
kind='round'` `fight_events` row the first time it's fetched, and no column
anywhere records whether a labeller later touched it. The only honest signal
available is exact-match:

```
is_seeded_unverified = (label_event.frame == round.start_frame
                         and label_event.end_frame == round.end_frame)
```

This has a known false-negative (a labeller who reviewed and left it
unchanged looks identical to one who never opened it) — accept it, since it
errs toward showing more "unverified" rounds, never fewer, matching the
honesty rule's bias.

Implementation: compute this in `labels_db.build_labels()` (which already
reads both `fight_events` and can join `rounds`), stamp it onto each `Round`
label, thread it through `score_rounds()` into a new `seeded: bool` field on
`RoundScore.matched` entries. The frontend renders "Seeded — not verified"
instead of an IoU % when true.

### Phase 4 — frontend

- New route `/accuracy` in `frontend/src/App.tsx` (alongside the existing
  four routes at `App.tsx:42-46`) → `frontend/src/pages/PipelineAccuracy.tsx`.
- New nav entry in `frontend/src/components/Header.tsx`.
- New folder `frontend/src/components/accuracy/`, mirroring the existing
  `player/`/`annotate/` convention. Component-to-design mapping:

  | Design piece | Component | Reuse |
  |---|---|---|
  | Provenance line | `ProvenanceLine.tsx` | new (trivial) |
  | E0 not-measurable | `NotMeasurable.tsx` | new — copyable CLI command |
  | E1 headline | `HeadlineF1.tsx` | reuse `AccGauge` (F1 ring) + `MiniStat` (P/R/TP/FP/FN tiles); new `ChangeTile.tsx` for vs-previous/vs-baseline |
  | E2 fixture table | `FixtureTable.tsx` | new |
  | E3 classification | `ClassificationBreakdown.tsx` | reuse `SegBar`; new `CircularBadge`/`NotMeasuredBadge` (shared) |
  | E4 family confusion | `ConfusionHeatmap.tsx` | new, parametrized so E6 reuses it for the 3×3 state matrix |
  | E5 timing | `OffsetDotStrip.tsx` | new (dot strip, not `PaceChart`'s area/line shape — borrow its SVG/viewBox scaffolding only) |
  | E6 fight state | `StateDumbbell.tsx` + shared `ConfusionHeatmap` | new dumbbell |
  | E7 rounds | `RoundsCheck.tsx` | new — "Seeded — not verified" via `NotMeasuredBadge` |
  | E8 version trend | `VersionTrendChart.tsx` | new — needs hollow markers (constants changed) + line-break-with-note (tolerance/fixture-set changed), which `PaceChart` has no equivalent of |
  | E9 worst misses/FPs | `WorstMissesList.tsx`, `WorstFPList.tsx` | new |

- **Colors**: reuse `frontend/src/utils/eventTaxonomy.ts`'s
  `colorForAction`/`iconForAction` for family/action rows — build a pseudo
  action string (`` `${family}_${target}` ``) since eval's `Strike.family`/
  `.target` are decomposed while `eventTaxonomy.ts` keys off pipeline action
  strings. **Fight-state colors must NOT copy `AnnotationTimeline.tsx`'s
  scheme** (`GROUND → var(--f-red)`, confirmed at `AnnotationTimeline.tsx:379`)
  — that's the red-corner collision the design brief calls out (memory
  `frontend-palette-collisions`). Use a local mapping in the new components:
  `STRIKING: var(--cyan-600)`, `CLINCH: var(--orange-400)`,
  `GROUND: var(--purple-600)` — confirmed these tokens already exist in
  `frontend/src/index.css` (`--cyan-600: #0099b0`, `--orange-400: #ff7043`,
  `--purple-600: #7c3aed`), so this needs no new CSS variables. Do not touch
  `AnnotationTimeline.tsx` itself — out of scope.
- **Visual system**: confirmed the real `index.css` already matches the
  mockup's `assets/brand.css` near-verbatim (same glass-card tokens, same
  `--f-red`/`--f-blue`/`--accent` values) — no new design tokens needed,
  reuse the existing dark glass-card system as-is.
- **E9 click-through**: no `?frame=` param support exists on `Player.tsx`
  today. Stub the click as `navigate(`/fights/${scored_fight_id}`)` with no
  auto-seek for the first cut; add `useSearchParams`-based seeking as a
  fast-follow, not a blocker.

### Sequencing

1. **Phase 0** (`score-pair`) — unblocks getting a first real number today,
   no UI required. Confirm which of "fight 60"/"fight 62" is your
   `purpose='reference'` fixture vs. the `purpose='ai_labeled'` scored fight
   before running it (the workflow needs one of each per fixture).
2. **Phase 1 + 2** (migration, persistence, minimal API) — first row in
   `eval_runs`.
3. **Phase 4, cut down to E0/E1/E2/E8 only** — demoable version-comparison
   view, even with just 1-2 trend points initially. This is the part that
   directly answers "did the last pipeline change help or hurt."
4. **Phase 3 + remaining Phase 4** (E3, E4/E6 heatmap, E5, E7, E9) — the
   deeper breakdown, once the above is validated against your real data.

## Verification

- `python -m eval.cli score-pair --labels-fight-id <ref> --predictions-fight-id <scored> --json /tmp/run.json` produces a report whose numbers match hand-checking a few strikes in the Annotate/Player view.
- After the migration: `eval_runs` table exists (`\d eval_runs` in psql), a `--write-db` run inserts one row.
- `GET /eval-runs/fixtures`, `GET /eval-runs/?reference_fight_id=...`, `GET /eval-runs/{id}` return the expected shapes via `curl`/the FastAPI `/docs` page.
- `/accuracy` in the browser: shows E0 for a fixture with no runs, E1/E2/E8 populated for the reference/fight-62 pair after Phase 1's manual run, matching the numbers `score-pair`'s CLI output printed.
- Re-run `score-pair --write-db` a second time (simulating a new pipeline version) and confirm E8's trend chart picks up the second point.
